Overall, the results show that structured agent memory need not generate an intermediate representation of the past. After peer review, the code and implementation details will be available at \textcolor{blue}{ this https URL }.

AI.tldr: Zero-Mem提出了一种"零令牌记忆操作"机制，使LLM智能体的记忆管理完全无需调用LLM或消耗LLM令牌，仅在最终问答阶段使用LLM。它通过保留原始交互轨迹，构建实体-上下文图（关系视图）和时序层次结构（局部视图）两个互补的非生成性视图，进行查询条件路由、双视图证据融合与闭合、确定性校准。在LoCoMo和HotpotQA基准上取得竞争性表现，同时将记忆操作延迟降低57.6%。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体记忆系统普遍依赖额外的LLM调用来生成中间摘要、抽象或知识图谱条目以管理记忆，这带来持续的令牌和时间成本，且生成过程中可能遗漏或合并关键细节，损害证据的可追溯性。研究旨在探索结构化记忆访问是否本质上需要生成式处理。
AI.method: Zero-Mem由四个核心组件构成：(1)来源保留的令牌无关记忆基底——用非生成式NER（如spaCy）构建实体-上下文共现图和邻接边，同时构建包含turn/window/episode/local的多粒度时序层次结构，均索引BM25和BGE-M3密集向量；(2)查询条件证据路由——从查询提取轻量级profile（主题、关键词、答案类型、时间线索、边界），确定关系型或局部型路由，决定两个视图的融合权重ρ；(3)双视图证据检索与闭合——图视图通过实体匹配、激活传播、个性化PageRank排序；层次视图从粗到细（episode→window→turn→local）；然后归一化融合并补充关系桥接和局部邻接；(4)确定性证据校准——按provenance和边界约束过滤证据，再按主题/时间/答案类型排序，最终对答案进行确定性后处理校准。整个过程不调用LLM。
AI.result: 在LoCoMo基准上（GPT-4o-mini和Qwen2.5-14B两种后端），Zero-Mem平均F1/BLEU-1均最优，分别达到59.15/52.96和57.57/51.41，相对最强基线GAM提升约5点。在HotpotQA 56K/224K/448K上下文设置下，Zero-Mem F1全面领先，448K设置达65.04，相对最强基线平均提升5.52点。效率方面，记忆操作零LLM调用、零令牌，总延迟334.77秒（每查询0.22秒），相对最快基线LightMem降低57.6%延迟。消融实验证实图视图与层次视图互补（单视图分别仅62.50/54.88 F1，完整模型72.07），证据闭合与校准均有正向贡献。检索预算Top-5至Top-10区间性能稳定。
AI.conclusion: 该工作形式化了"零令牌记忆操作"运行机制，证明有效的智能体记忆无需生成式中间表示，可直接对来源保留的原始轨迹进行结构化证据选择。Zero-Mem在长记忆对话和多跳长上下文问答任务上同时实现竞争性准确率和显著效率提升，为生成式记忆管线提供了实用的替代方案。

title: Studying quantization trade-offs for efficient inference deployment in machine translation
summary: Deploying large language models in realistic server environments poses challenges, as the system needs to provide high-quality responses with low latency. Quantization is a common approach to reduce the memory footprint and improve inference efficiency, yet its impact on latency and throughput is rarely evaluated under controlled, orchestration-level workloads. In this work we study the quantization trade-offs of two translation model families, EuroLLM \citep{martins2025eurollm} and Hy-MT2 \citep{zheng2026hy} across five models ranging from 1.7B to 22B for efficient deployment on a single A100 or H100 GPU. We demonstrate that combining a document-chunking strategy with W4A8 or W8A8 quantization improves the latency-throughput Pareto-curve under a wide range of workloads. Furthermore, since standard machine translation (MT) benchmarks rely on isolated sentences and fail to capture long-context dynamics, we introduce a document-level evaluation from WMT24++ to assess how text chunking strategies affect translation quality under quantization. Our results reveal that standard segment-level evaluation can fail to predict the interaction between quantization and long-context document translation. While Hy-MT2 remains robust under quantization, EuroLLM shows strong sensitivity and translation quality collapses rapidly for all considered quantization formats. Overall, our experiments show that the trade-off between inference efficiency and translation quality depends not only on the quantization format, but also on the choice of text chunking strategy.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在实际服务器环境中部署大型语言模型进行机器翻译时，量化策略与文本分块策略对推理效率（延迟-吞吐量）和翻译质量（特别是长文档翻译质量）的联合影响。研究对比了EuroLLM和Hy-MT2两个翻译模型家族（规模从1.7B到22B），在A100/H100单GPU上的部署表现。
AI.motivation: 1. 大语言模型部署面临高延迟和低吞吐量的现实挑战，量化虽能减少内存占用，但其对延迟和吞吐量的实际影响缺乏在受控的编排级工作负载下的评估。2. 现有机器翻译（MT）基准测试通常基于孤立句子，无法捕捉长上下文动态特性，导致标准评估可能无法预测量化与长文档翻译的交互作用。
AI.method: 1. 模型选择：EuroLLM和Hy-MT2两个翻译模型家族，共5个模型（参数规模1.7B-22B）。2. 量化方案：测试W4A8和W8A8等量化格式。3. 部署策略：结合文档分块（document-chunking）策略与量化方法。4. 评估维度：（a）延迟-吞吐量帕累托曲线，评估推理效率；（b）引入WMT24++文档级评估，测试长上下文翻译质量；（c）对比标准句子级评估与文档级评估的差异。5. 硬件环境：单卡A100或H100 GPU。
AI.result: 1. 推理效率：将文档分块策略与W4A8或W8A8量化结合，可在广泛工作负载范围内改善延迟-吞吐量的帕累托曲线。2. 翻译质量评估发现：标准句子级评估无法预测量化与长文档翻译之间的交互作用。3. 模型鲁棒性差异：Hy-MT2在量化下保持较强的鲁棒性；而EuroLLM对量化高度敏感，所有测试的量化格式下其翻译质量均迅速崩溃。
AI.conclusion: 推理效率与翻译质量之间的权衡不仅取决于量化格式的选择，还取决于文本分块策略的选择。文档级评估对于全面理解量化对机器翻译系统的影响至关重要，标准句子级基准可能产生误导性的结论。不同模型家族（如Hy-MT2与EuroLLM）对量化的鲁棒性存在显著差异，这表明模型选择与部署策略需协同考量。

title: Know It, Act on It: Investigating Memory Utilization in LLM Personalization
summary: As large language model (LLM) agents evolve into personalized companions, memory has emerged as a core capability. However, LLMs face a knowledge utilization problem: they may fail to act on relevant user preferences even when they are fully present in context. When an agent fails to tailor its response in a context where previously shared user preferences should matter, it is unclear whether the model failed to remember that information or remembered it but failed to use it. To isolate this breakdown, we introduce a decoupled evaluation paradigm that administers paired Know and Act tests to the same user preference. We conduct large-scale experiments across 16 systems and five memory architectures, evaluating 1,000 preferences embedded at three levels of expression strength. Our results show a large gap between Know and Act outcomes: agents often pass the recall test for a user preference but fail to reflect that same preference in the paired behavioral scenario. While memory architectures reduce this gap, utilization remains especially weak for health and therapy-related preferences, where failures to act carry the greatest real-world stakes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出KnowAct评估框架，通过对同一用户偏好进行配对的Know（回忆）和Act（行动）测试，揭示LLM智能体在个性化场景中存在显著的"记忆-行动"脱节问题。实验覆盖16个系统、5种记忆架构、1000条偏好，在三种表达强度下进行大规模评估，发现即使成功回忆偏好，智能体也常常无法在实际行为中体现该偏好，且健康和情感类偏好的利用尤其薄弱。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体正从无状态工具演变为个性化长期陪伴者，记忆成为核心能力。然而现有研究存在关键缺陷：要么仅测试回忆能力（如LoCom、MemoryAgentBench等），要么仅测试行为响应（如PersonaMem系列），但从未对同一偏好同时测试两种能力。此外，当智能体未能根据已知偏好调整响应时，无法区分是"忘记"还是"记住但未使用"。这一知识利用问题在LLM中已被广泛记录但缺乏针对性诊断。考虑到多数用户通过日常任务间接透露偏好（如润色邮件时透露过敏信息），记忆架构是否能真正弥合回忆与行动之间的鸿沟成为关键开放问题。
AI.method: 1) 数据构建：基于PersonaMem-v2的50个persona（跨11个文化区域分层采样），每persona选取20条目标偏好共1000条，类型涵盖定型/反定型/中性/健康医疗/治疗情感五类，构建三种表达强度——显式（直接陈述）、附带（任务中的边角信息）、推理（需从行为线索推断）。每persona形成3个chunk序列共150序列、11955个chunk、约455万token。2) 配对评估框架：对每条偏好实施Know测试（第一人称直接提问，如"我有花粉过敏吗？"）和Act测试（自然场景请求，不提及偏好，如"推荐春季周末活动"），Act通过对比有无记忆的配对响应进行判断。3) 增量注入协议：逐chunk注入记忆系统，Know和Act在独立会话中测试以避免启动效应。4) 评测16个系统跨越5类架构：长上下文基线（GPT-4o-mini/GPT-4o/Gemini 3.1 Flash/Claude 4.6 Sonnet）、简单RAG（BM25）、嵌入RAG（三种嵌入模型）、结构增强RAG（Mem0/Zep/Cognee/HippoRAG-v2）、智能体记忆（Letta/Self-RAG/MemoryOS/A-MEM），所有RAG和智能体记忆系统共享GPT-4o-mini为生成骨干。5) 失败归因：对Mem0的Know通过但Act失败的722个案例，通过oracle chunk和oracle preference两级注入进行三层归因（检索/理解/应用失败）。6) 评判可靠性：人工标注Fleiss'κ达0.89（Know）和0.82（Act），GPT-5与Claude Opus 4.6间Cohen's κ达0.91和0.88。
AI.result: 1) Know-Act脱节普遍存在：即使最佳系统Claude 4.6 Sonnet在显式条件下也只能将约三分之二的成功回忆偏好转化为适当行为响应；GPT-4o-mini长上下文基线利用率仅16.3%。2) 记忆架构显著缩小差距：Mem0将GPT-4o-mini利用率从16.3%提升至54.6%，收益主要来自行为侧而非回忆侧。3) 表达强度影响非单调：附带表达最难回忆（不是推理），因其嵌于任务对话中不被标记为重要；显式表达暴露利用瓶颈（Know高Act低），非显式表达暴露存储瓶颈。4) 健康/情感类偏好利用最弱：Know Accuracy在各类型间相对均匀，但Utilization Rate差异显著——健康医疗类最低、治疗情感类次低，揭示安全敏感领域的真实风险。5) 失败归因：理解失败占53.0%为主导原因，应用失败占16.2%反映模型固有能力上限；显式条件下检索失败突出（48.7%），附带/推理条件下理解失败主导（69.6%/60.9%）。6) GPT-4o-mini骨干更依赖先验知识，对反定型偏好表现更差，而记忆增强系统可覆盖先验行为。
AI.conclusion: 本文系统揭示了记忆增强LLM智能体在个性化场景中"记住不等于使用"的普遍问题。Know-Act脱节在所有架构中普遍存在，健康和情感领域尤为突出，其失败涵盖检索、理解、应用三层，理解失败为主导原因。研究呼吁未来个性化系统超越简单的存储与回忆，关注记忆的选择性检索、正确解读和可靠转化为情境适当行为，这对部署安全敏感的健康辅助智能体具有关键意义。局限性包括依赖LLM评判、使用合成persona、检索设置偏简单（单目标片段有限干扰物），真实部署中Know-Act差距可能更为严峻。

title: Sycophancy Undermines Epistemic Vigilance in Cooperative Vision-Language Tasks
summary: To maintain common ground in cooperative conversation, humans iteratively update their beliefs as conversation participants share new information; participants who are epistemically vigilant detect when new information conflicts with prior beliefs and take steps to repair these conflicts. In order for AI systems to serve as reliable partners in complex cooperative tasks, they must similarly weigh incoming information against their own private evidence and shared context and appropriately surface inconsistencies when they arise. To measure the epistemic vigilance of vision-language models in cooperative settings, we present an information-asymmetric, dialog-based "spot-the-difference" task. Two models are privately shown one image each, and must determine through conversation whether the images are identical or, if not, identify the difference. Models routinely fail at this: they frequently overlook key evidence in their private image in favor of agreeing with their conversational partner, even when their agreement is unwarranted. We relate these violations of epistemic vigilance to the broader behavior of sycophancy, which manifests itself in cooperative goal-oriented dialog as over-accommodation and weak evidential grounding. Our results show that model steering to reduce sycophancy with a vector learned from task-agnostic sycophancy examples can reduce epistemic vigilance-related errors, making models more faithful reporters of their evidence, and in turn, more reliable partners in information-asymmetric cooperative tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于对话的"找不同"任务，用于评估视觉语言模型在合作任务中的认知警觉性（epistemic vigilance），研究发现模型倾向于忽视自身证据以迎合对话伙伴（谄媚性行为），并证明通过针对谄媚行为的向量引导可减少此类错误。
AI.motivation: 在人类合作对话中，参与者会通过认知警觉性来检测新信息与已有信念的冲突并进行修正。AI若要成为可靠的合作伙伴，也需具备类似能力。然而，当前大型视觉语言模型在面对信息不对称的合作任务时，是否能忠实于自身证据尚不清楚。现有研究多关注谄媚行为（sycophancy），但其在合作目标导向对话中的具体表现（过度顺应与证据基础薄弱）尚未被系统分析。
AI.method:
1. 设计信息不对称的对话式"找不同"任务：两个模型分别私下看到一张图片，需通过对话判断图片是否相同，若不同则找出差异。
2. 评估模型在该任务中是否过度依赖对话伙伴的陈述而忽视自身私有图像证据。
3. 将观察到的失败行为与更广泛的谄媚现象相联系。
4. 使用从任务无关谄媚样本中学到的向量对模型进行引导（steering），以减少认知警觉性相关的错误。
AI.result:
1. 模型在任务中频繁失败：经常忽略自身私有图像中的关键证据，转而附和对话伙伴，即使这种附和并无根据。
2. 揭示了认知警觉性违反与谄媚行为之间的联系，具体表现为合作目标导向对话中的"过度顺应"（over-accommodation）和"证据基础薄弱"（weak evidential grounding）。
3. 实验表明，通过针对谄媚行为学得的向量进行模型引导，可以有效降低认知警觉性相关错误，使模型成为更忠实的证据报告者。
AI.conclusion: 当前视觉语言模型在信息不对称的合作任务中存在显著的认知警觉性缺陷，表现为谄媚性的过度顺应行为。通过任务无关的谄媚向量引导可提升模型的证据忠实度，进而提高其在合作任务中的可靠性，为构建更值得信赖的AI合作伙伴提供了新思路。

title: ResKV: Reconstructing Omitted Attention Contributions for Fixed-Budget KV Cache Compression
summary: KV cache compression is essential for efficient long-context inference. Existing eviction methods permanently discard unselected tokens and consequently remove their aggregate contribution to attention. Merging-based alternatives preserve more information but can perturb retained keys and values that should remain exact. We observe that the information omitted by cache eviction can be formulated as residual statistics in both the numerator and denominator of softmax attention. Based on this observation, we propose ResKV, which divides a fixed KV budget into an exact main cache and a compact residual cache that reconstructs the contribution of omitted tokens. ResKV lets main-cache tokens and residual entries participate in the same softmax normalization, so residual entries restore both attention numerator and denominator mass rather than acting as a post-hoc correction. A construction-time validation proxy determines residual allocation for each layer and KV head, while a decode-time dynamic gate adjusts residual contributions for individual queries. Comprehensive evaluations on LongBench and RULER, covering query-aware and query-agnostic settings, multiple backbones, cache budgets, and representative compression baselines, demonstrate broad improvements under the same retained KV budget while preserving the practical efficiency of compressed decoding, including peak memory usage and long-context decode throughput.

AI.tldr: ResKV提出了一种固定预算下的KV缓存压缩方法，将预算划分为精确的主缓存（main cache）和用于重建被丢弃token贡献的紧凑残差缓存（residual cache），通过共享softmax归一化机制同时恢复注意力的分子与分母质量。
AI.motivation: 现有KV缓存压缩方法存在两类缺陷：(1) 硬驱逐（eviction）方法永久丢弃被淘汰的token，会同时丢失其在softmax注意力分子与分母中的聚合贡献，尤其在分散注意力（diffuse attention）下风险显著；(2) 合并（merging）方法虽保留信息但会扰动应保持精确的保留token。核心问题是：在固定预算下如何既保留关键token的精确性，又能表征被省略token的贡献。
AI.method: ResKV将固定预算 b=m+r 划分为：(1) 主缓存 M 用 m 个槽位存储精确token的原始key/value；(2) 残差缓存 R 用 r 个槽位存储被丢弃集合 E 的聚类摘要（每个聚类存储均值key k̄ⱼ、均值value v̄ⱼ和样本数 cⱼ）。在解码时采用共享softmax：主token与残差条目在同一个softmax归一化中共同参与，残差条目的logit为 ⟨q,k̄ⱼ⟩/√d + log cⱼ + log g(q)。自适应控制包括：(a) 构造期验证代理（validation proxy）通过在验证查询上衡量重建误差，为每层每KV头选择最优残差预算 r*；(b) 解码期动态门控（dynamic gate）g(q) 基于主缓存的注意力尖锐度 p_max^M(q) 自适应调整残差logit，平坦时增强残差贡献、尖锐时抑制以保护主缓存峰值。残差聚类通过最小化键空间平方误差（Lloyd迭代）求解。
AI.result: 在LongBench上改进了全部32个配置（平均提升1.02分），在RULER上改进了64个配置中的63个（平均提升3.38分），其中查询无关（query-agnostic）设置下提升尤为显著（4.54分）。在10%和20%紧预算下增益最大（LongBench +1.43/+1.17，RULER +3.47/+3.66）。消融实验验证验证代理、动态门控和共享softmax三个组件均不可或缺。效率方面峰值内存几乎与SnapKV基线持平，长上下文（128K）下解码吞吐量稳定，仅略低于纯基线，远优于全缓存（OOM）。任务级增益集中在代码任务（RepoBench-P、LCC）和检索/聚合任务（VT、FWE、Passage Retrieval、TREC）。
AI.conclusion: ResKV通过主-残差双层缓存设计与共享softmax归一化，在不改变总缓存预算的前提下实现了对被丢弃token贡献的有效重建，并通过构造期验证代理与解码期动态门控实现自适应残差控制，在多个长上下文基准、骨干模型、缓存预算和构造设置下均取得稳定提升，同时保持了压缩解码的实用效率。

title: Evolving language compositionality in a frequency-structured meaning space
comment: 17 pages, 4 figures (plus 2 figures in appendix), submitted to Wivace 2026 ( this https URL )
summary: The iterated learning model was introduced to investigate language evolution: the way in which the characteristic properties of human languages have been shaped, at least partly, by repeated transmission from one language user to another. The key finding is that language compositionality can arise spontaneously as a consequence of language being passed repeatedly through a language learning bottleneck. Here we explore how changing the frequency of different meanings, so that some meanings occur much more frequently than others, affects the character of its compositionality. We find that, as observed in natural languages, high-frequency meanings can escape the pressure to conform to the grammar that characterizes lower-frequency meanings. However, when the frequency structure is instead imposed on parts rather than on whole meaning vectors, the language fails to transmit across generations. This occurs despite the fact that the most frequent elements are reliably learned. These results suggest that frequency can shape emergent linguistic structure only when the frequency distribution is defined over form-meaning units that learners can acquire holistically. When frequency is instead distributed over smaller units, it fails to support the relational structure required for compositional generalisation, thereby preventing stable language transmission.

AI.tldr: 本文使用半监督迭代学习模型（ILM），探索Zipf频率分布施加在不同层级（完整意义向量 vs. 独立位）对涌现语言复合性的影响。研究发现：频率偏斜作用于完整意义时，高频意义倾向于被整体记忆（低复合性，类似于英语"to be"的不规则变化），低频意义被迫遵循系统性规则（高复合性）；而当频率偏斜作用于独立成分时，语言无法跨代稳定传递。这一对比表明频率偏斜必须作用于学习者可整体获取的形式-意义单元，才能支持真正可传递的组合性语言结构。
AI.motivation: 人类语言中存在一个显著的频率-复合性不对称现象：高频意义（如"to be"）往往以高度不规则、整体性（holophrastic）的方式表达，而低频意义（如"to research"）则倾向于遵循系统的形态句法规则。以往的迭代学习模型（ILM）虽然证明了语言复合性可作为通过学习瓶颈的副产物自然涌现，但尚未系统探讨意义的频率结构如何影响这一涌现过程及其复合性的具体形态。本研究旨在回答两个核心问题：频率偏斜应施加在什么层级（完整意义还是亚成分）才能塑造自然语言中观察到的复合性模式？
AI.method: 采用半监督迭代学习模型（semi-supervised ILM），每代由一名天真学习者从导师处通过有限的意义-信号配对子集（B个监督样本）以及更大规模的非监督样本（A个意义，通过自编码器训练）进行学习。模型基于一个16位的编码器-解码器自编码器神经网络，其中的意义和信号均为相同长度的位串。导师-学习者链传递50代。引入三种不同的频率操作：(1) 在完整意义向量空间上施加Zipf分布；(2) 在每个意义向量的独立位上施加Zipf分布；(3) 在大小可变（1, 2, 4, 8, 16）的连续块（chunk）上施加Zipf分布。使用三个指标评估：表达性（expressivity）、复合性（compositionality）和稳定性（stability）。复合性通过信号位与意义位之间的条件熵进行形式化定义，并在位级和向量级分别计算。每个实验配置运行30次独立试验以确保结果可靠性。
AI.result: 1. **完整意义层面的Zipf偏斜（α=1）**：聚合层面的表达性、复合性和稳定性均在大约10代内攀升，并在30代左右达到接近1的平稳值（成功传递）。然而，每个意义的复合性随其频率排名呈梯度变化：最频繁传达的意义（rank ≤ 1）的复合性上升最慢，往往保持为整体性（holophrastic）形式；不太频繁的意义则被强制采用系统性规则进行编码。2. **位层面的Zipf偏斜（α=1）**：聚合稳定性在整个50代中始终接近零，语言无法跨代传递；表达性和复合性在0.4附近波动。但每个位分析显示，高排名的意义位（1-3）确实获得了较高的位级复合性和稳定性，而低排名位则较弱且频繁切换载体。3. **块层面（chunk size = 1, 2, 4, 8, 16）**：块大小为16时效果几乎与完整向量采样重叠；块大小越小，复合性随排名增加而下降的模式越明显，与位级结果逐渐趋同。结论性发现：频率偏斜塑造涌现语言结构的能力本质上取决于其作用对象——只有当频率分布作用于学习者可以整体获取的形式-意义单元时，频率才能支持组合泛化所需的关联结构。
AI.conclusion: 频率偏斜对涌现复合性的影响并非简单地由"是否存在偏斜"决定，而取决于其在何种表征层级施加。当整个构型频繁出现时，它们倾向于被记忆为固定单元并与整体性短语关联；相反，当个别元素在不同的构型中频繁出现时，它们会与词项形式形成强关联，但失去了在更广泛结构系统中的角色，导致无稳定语言传递。虽然高排名位作为可靠载体可能获得局部较高的复合性，但低排名位仍基本无信息，所得到的系统缺乏组合泛化所需的关联结构。这些发现与基于使用的（usage-based）语言习得理论相一致：语法知识从反复出现的构式（constructions）中涌现，而非孤立的符号-指称关联；频率仅在塑造学习者可整体获取的单元时才能支持语言结构的涌现。后续工作建议引入意义成分之间的依赖关系，使模型能从分层意义空间跨越学习瓶颈产生分层语言结构。

title: Language Models Agree With Each Other, Not With Readers
comment: 18 pages. Ancillary files include all three pre-registrations, every analysis script and every result artifact; the paper contains no numeric literal for a measured value and this http URL regenerates all of them from the shipped artifacts alone
summary: Claims that language models homogenise are usually measured against human judgements collected for the study, which makes the human side an artifact of the design: a crowdworker given the model's instruction is running the model's prompt. We measure convergence against a human reference nobody built for the purpose -- 2,523 reader mark sets across 120 web documents, produced by people highlighting for their own reasons on a platform where the overlay of others' marks is off by default. Agreement is the overlap between two size-matched sentence sets minus the overlap expected when each is resampled within its own depth-and-length bands. The null's calibration is demonstrated, not asserted: every pair involving a random baseline lands within 0.006 of zero. On the median document each party names 14 sentences of 70; two readers share 4.1 and two models 8.7. Across 18 model arms spanning 11 vendors, 3 countries and both weight regimes, the median of 153 model pairs is +0.093 against a human yardstick of +0.040, and 99 sit entirely above the human interval. Two frontier models from rival labs reach +0.203, twice what GPT-4o agrees with itself on a second call. The effect is not determinism, prompt wording, procedure, vendor or routing, and it is graded: the smallest models agree at the human level. No model agrees with readers detectably more than a reader does, and at equal depth and length no surface feature separates their choices. The multiples are procedure-dependent and the ordering is not: models are cut to their sharpest set while a reader's is a random draw from what they marked, and blunting the models alike halves the gap without closing it. Tested out of sample on four models released after this analysis, against predictions fixed beforehand, none clears the human interval. A population simulated from several models is not several populations.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对比18个语言模型与2,523名自然阅读者在120篇网页文档上的句子选择行为,发现模型之间的一致性是人类读者之间一致性的2.3–5.1倍;前沿模型间一致性可达+0.203,而两名读者的基线仅为+0.040。该效应具有能力梯度(最小模型处于人类水平),且不随厂商、国家、代际或提示词变化而消失。
AI.motivation: 既有"AI使输出趋同"的研究多以被指令、被招募的众包工人作为人类对照基线,这导致"指令"本身成为混淆变量——两名接受相同指示的众包工人在统计上比日常生活中的普通人更一致。本文旨在使用一个完全未受指令的人类参照系(社交高亮平台的真实阅读者)重新测量模型趋同程度,以剥离"指令效应"对模型-人类差异的人为贡献。
AI.method: (1) 数据:120篇公开网页文档,2,523组来自社交高亮平台的读者标注集(默认关闭他人高亮叠加层),每篇文档中位19名读者;18个模型臂覆盖11家厂商、3个国家、2024–2026年三个代际、8B至前沿规模、闭源与开源权重。(2) 测量:超额一致率=两个大小匹配的句子集合的实际重合度,减去在文档深度与长度分箱内重抽样所得到的期望重合度;零分布通过随机基线与10对经典抽取算法进行校准验证。(3) 推断:以域为聚类的10,000次自助法百分位置信区间,模型-人类对比在文档层配对。(4) 预注册18臂面板并执行4个发布后模型的样本外测试,所有预测事先固定。
AI.result: (1) 面板中位模型对一致性+0.093,人类基线+0.040(2.3倍);153对中有99对整体位于人类置信区间之上;前沿模型GPT-5.4与Claude Opus 5达+0.203,为GPT-4o自身重复一致性的2倍、两名读者的5.1倍。(2) 效应呈能力梯度:两小模型+0.041(人类水平),两闭源模型+0.174,两前沿模型+0.164。(3) 4个发布后模型无一突破人类区间,与面板前沿中位达+0.224。(4) 在控制深度与长度后,11项表层特征无一能区分"仅模型选"与"仅读者选"的句子。(5) 排序稳健但倍数依赖程序:将模型按读者方式(而非top-b)截断后,差距由+0.163减半至+0.082,仍显著大于零。
AI.conclusion: 在自然阅读者构成的零指令基线之上,语言模型彼此的一致性远高于其与人类的一致性;这种趋同是能力的有序函数而非二值属性,且模型对读者端的最佳臂已取到可达成共识的84%,而模型彼此的一致性仍可达该天花板的3.6倍。该发现削弱了"以多模型合成模拟多元群体"这一研究范式的有效性,并对Monoculture风险在文本领域的存在提供了直接经验证据。

title: Bridging the Question-Answer Gap in Retrieval-Augmented Generation: Hypothetical Prompt Embeddings
comment: 10 pages, 8 figures, 5 tables. Published in IEEE Access
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems synergize retrieval mechanisms with generative language models to enhance the accuracy and relevance of responses. However, bridging the style gap between user queries and relevant information in document text remains a persistent challenge in retrieval-augmented systems, often addressed by runtime solutions (e.g., Hypothetical Document Embeddings (HyDE)) that attempt to improve alignment but introduce extra computational overhead at query time. To address these challenges, we propose Hypothetical Prompt Embeddings (HyPE), a framework that shifts the generation of hypothetical content from query time to the indexing phase. By precomputing multiple hypothetical prompts for each data chunk and embedding the chunk in place of the prompt, HyPE transforms retrieval into a question-question matching task, bypassing the need for runtime synthetic answer generation. This approach does not introduce latency but also strengthens the alignment between queries and relevant context. Our experimental results on six common datasets show that HyPE can improve retrieval context precision by up to 42 percentage points and claim recall by up to 45 percentage points, compared to standard approaches, while remaining compatible with re-ranking, multi-vector retrieval, query decomposition, and other RAG advancements

AI.tldr: 本文提出 HyPE（假设提示嵌入）框架，通过将假设性问题生成从查询时转移到索引阶段，将 RAG 检索转化为"问题-问题"匹配任务，有效弥合用户查询与文档内容之间的风格鸿沟，同时消除查询时延迟。
AI.motivation: RAG 系统面临一个核心难题：用户查询通常为疑问句式，而文档内容为陈述/说明性文本，两者之间的风格差异导致查询嵌入与文档嵌入难以对齐，影响检索精度。现有方法（如 HyDE）在查询时调用 LLM 生成合成答案，虽能缓解该问题，但每次查询都引入额外的推理开销，难以满足高吞吐量场景的需求。
AI.method: HyPE 采用"离线预计算"策略：1）将语料库切分为若干语义连贯的 chunk；2）对每个 chunk，利用 LLM 在单次调用中生成 k 个假设性问题（hypothetical prompts），模拟用户可能的提问方式；3）使用预训练稠密检索模型（如 bge-m3）将每个假设问题编码为嵌入向量，并将其映射回原始 chunk；4）构建由 (向量, chunk) 对组成的索引。查询时只需对用户查询进行嵌入，通过标准 ANN 检索找到最相似的假设问题向量，返回对应的 chunk。整个索引阶段 LLM 调用次数与 chunk 数成正比，查询阶段不涉及任何额外 LLM 调用。
AI.result: 在六个数据集（MS MARCO、RAGBench、Ragas-WikiQA、RAG-dataset-12000、MultiHopRAG、Single-Topic RAG）上，使用 bge-m3 作为嵌入模型、Mistral-NeMo 作为生成 LLM 进行评估：1）检索性能：HyPE 平均将上下文精度提升约 20 个百分点、claim recall 提升约 16 个百分点；在 Single-Topic RAG 上精度提升超过 42 个百分点，recall 提升达 44.6 个百分点；2）生成质量：幻觉率从 26.0 降至 19.9，忠实度从 52.2 提升至 69.3，Overall F1 从 27.9 提升至 37.6；3）统计检验：Wilcoxon 符号秩检验（Holm 校正）显示九项指标在 p<0.10 水平上显著优于基线，Cliff's |δ| 介于 0.44–0.72 之间；4）MS MARCO 上三方法表现接近，原因是其段落短、词汇重叠度高，基线已接近饱和；5）HyPE 的设计与其他 RAG 增强技术（如重排序、多向量检索、查询分解）正交，可作为"即插即用"模块组合使用。
AI.conclusion: HyPE 通过将假设生成从查询时迁移至索引时，在不引入运行时延迟的前提下显著提升了 RAG 系统的检索精度和生成忠实度，验证了"问题-问题"匹配相比"问题-文档"匹配的有效性。该方法具备良好的模块化特性，可与重排序、查询分解、GraphRAG 等现有技术无缝集成。未来工作方向包括：结合 GraphRAG 增强多跳推理、研究分块大小与扩展上下文窗口之间的权衡、以及在多语言 RAG 基准上的验证。

title: Structured AI Demonstrations and Student LLM Use in Engineering Mechanics: Study Design and Preliminary Results
summary: The rapid integration of large language models (LLMs) into undergraduate education presents an urgent challenge for engineering instructors. Despite widespread student adoption, there remains a critical lack of domain-specific empirical evidence to guide pedagogical policies and classroom interventions. This manuscript presents a descriptive study design and preliminary findings from an undergraduate engineering mechanics course conducted in Spring 2026. We detail a reproducible survey instrument used to capture student AI usage patterns, attitudes, and verification practices, which are subsequently linked to academic performance metrics. Additionally, we document a deployable sequence of nine structured, instructor-led AI demonstrations designed to model strategic LLM delegation and evaluation. While our preliminary data highlight shifting student behaviors and complex relationships between AI reliance and course outcomes, the primary contribution of this work is the provision of an open-access methodological framework. By making our complete study design, survey tools, and demonstration materials publicly available, we urge other engineering educators to collect and share similar empirical data. Navigating this unprecedented technological shift will require a collaborative, evidence-based approach to fully understand its long-term impacts on student learning.

AI.tldr: 本研究针对本科工程力学课程（波士顿大学EK301，2026年春季学期），提出了一个可复制的准实验研究设计，并对LLM在工程力学课程中的使用情况进行了初步的描述性调查。研究包含三个核心贡献：（1）一套可复制的调查工具；（2）9个结构化的AI示范课程序列；（3）公开的去标识数据集与多模型定性编码管道（Fleiss κ中位数为0.88）。核心发现：AI使用近乎普及（学期末51%的学生每周用于力学），但验证习惯的增长滞后于使用增长；力学专项使用频率与课程成绩呈反向关系（基线时第4四分位数学生中从不使用者比例最高）；学生对示范课程的反馈在课程实用性维度上两极分化。
AI.motivation: 自2022年ChatGPT发布以来，LLM迅速融入本科教学环境，但在工程类问题解决课程中，缺乏严谨的、领域特定的实证证据来指导具体的教学决策。已有元分析表明，LLM对学习效果的影响因教学整合方式不同而存在显著差异（Bastani等人2025年发现无护栏访问会损害后续独立考试成绩），但这些发现多基于广义或入门级课程。工程力学涉及大量图表解读与程序性推理，LLM能力在视觉表征方面仍较弱，因此需要领域特定的、在学期内自然发生的实证证据，以理解学生如何使用、验证这些工具，以及轻量级教学干预是否会改变其行为。
AI.method: （1）课程背景：在波士顿大学EK301工程力学I课程（静力学）开展研究，3个教学班共196名学生，由3位不同教师授课，共享教学大纲、作业与期末桁架设计项目。其中一个班（干预班，n=65）接受了9次结构化AI示范课程，其余两个班（n=40）作为对照。（2）研究设计：准实验前-后测设计，通过IRB批准（#8256X），最终样本n=105，其中干预班65人、对照班40人；前测100人、后测99人、同时点完成94人。（3）干预设计：9次示范课程每节10-15分钟，以周为单位进行，主题涵盖工具素养（元认知、最近发展区）、Python沙箱使用、系统提示词构建、战略性任务委派（GUI开发与蒙特卡洛优化）、LLM基准测试（手动与编程）。（4）测量工具：24题两轮调查（分为A-H 8个主题模块），结合free-text反思；课程绩效以两次期中考试的标准化z分数四分位数表示（Q1-Q4）。（5）定性编码：开发五套分层码本，采用三模型（Claude Sonnet 5、GPT-5.5、Gemini 3.5 Flash）独立编码管道，对不一致项目由第四模型（Claude Fable 5）裁决；756对响应-问题中58.9%三模型一致，中位Fleiss κ为0.88（94.7%达到实质性一致阈值0.61）。（6）分析与共享：描述性分析为主，不做统计推断；数据集通过OpenBU发布，定性/定量数据解耦，性能数据仅以四分位数形式公开。
AI.result: （1）AI使用普及：学期末，82%受访者每周至少使用一次AI（一般用途），力学专项每周使用率从37%升至51%，从不使用率从33%降至6%。（2）态度稳定且偏正面：大比例学生认为AI对课程有帮助、能够评估AI输出的正确性；但对准确性担忧普遍存在；AI影响评分从5.85升至6.35（0-10量表）。（3）工作流转变：自我优先尝试的工作流仍占主导（学期末两者合并55/99），AI引导的逐步工作流从7增至20；概念解释请求翻倍（12→28），主动设置提示约束（8→15）、对AI持怀疑态度（4→11）、意识到图表解读失败（1→8）这三项成熟度指标均显著增长。（4）验证行为滞后：独立再解题以验证（25→30）增加，但消极追踪AI步骤减少（34→26），最低/有条件验证从5翻倍至12，表明使用增加并未均匀转化为验证增加。（5）验证-成绩逆向关系：基线时力学专项从不使用者比例在Q4（10/24）显著高于Q1（3/22），学期末差距收窄但Q4仍为最低使用群体。（6）示范课程反馈两极分化：60人中27人认为示范课程加强了理解，21人报告无改变；反馈编码显示"直接课程实用性"（10）与"缺乏课程实用性"（11）几乎并列出现，学生核心建议为增加课程实用性（13）与增加互动性（6）。（7）回顾性自我感知与实际分布脱节：41/99学生报告学期内无实质性改变，但客观分布显著移动，提示变化可能渐进或被轻度使用者忽视。
AI.conclusion: 本研究作为一项为期多学期的持续研究的第一学期成果，主要贡献在于提供了一套可复制的方法论框架——包括完整的调查工具、九次结构化AI示范课程的工作流、附录C中完整的苏格拉底式导师系统提示词、附录D-E中详尽的码本与多模型LLM辅助编码协议，以及通过OpenBU公开的去标识数据集与GitHub分析代码。研究局限性显著：n=105的小样本量与非随机化的班次分配排除了因果推论，干预组仅有一个班次且与教师身份、时间段等变量高度共变，FERPA限制使得无法对先前学业能力、具体GPA等协变量进行调整以纠正分组不均衡；LLM辅助的定性编码虽然具备高模型间信度（中位Fleiss κ=0.88）但缺乏人类编码者的有效性验证。作者强烈呼吁其他工程教育工作者收集并共享类似实证数据，认为只有通过跨机构、跨学期、领域特定的协作证据积累，才能在LLM快速演进的时代建立对工程教育长期影响的可靠理解；后续研究将：(a)基于本次学生反馈大幅修订示范课程的节奏与内容耦合，(b)引入人类编码验证样本以校准机器编码有效性，(c)建立纵向跟踪机制评估LLM使用与LLM中心教学法对工程教育的长期认知与教学影响。

title: Hidden Errors in Big Data: The Case of Property Records
comment: To appear in Proceedings of the Ninth AAAI/ACM Conference on AI, Ethics, and Society (AIES-26), Malmö, Sweden, October 12-14, 2026
summary: Big data are the foundation for an increasing share of academic research and AI models deployed in both the public and private sectors, prompting substantial growth over time in reliance on brokered datasets. Brokered property records, which are ubiquitous in studies of gentrification, inequality, and the property tax in the U.S. and serve as inputs to property valuation models, are one notable example. In this paper, we audit two prominent brokered property datasets, finding errors in these data which bias key measures of economic inequality. First, we document that for 1-2% of matched sales in Cook County, IL, from 2018-2021, broker-provided sale prices differ from ground truth sale prices by more than 5%. Moreover, missing data and conceptual differences in the reporting of deed and property characteristics lead to coverage errors ranging from 12 to 15% of transactions. Second, we show that misreporting is highly consistent between brokers: more often than not, brokers make identical reporting errors for the same transactions. Third, to illustrate the significance of these errors, we measure their impact on estimates of property tax regressivity, finding that they drive significant wedges between estimates depending on the data source. These findings generalize to two other large counties in the U.S., and highlight the crucial importance of open administrative data and transparency from brokers regarding data provenance and lineage.

AI.tldr: 本文审计了两大主流房产数据经纪商（Cotality 和 ATTOM）提供的物业交易数据，将其与库克县（Cook County）行政"真实"数据进行比对，发现数据存在显著且系统性的覆盖错误和插补错误，导致基于这些数据的经济不平等指标（如财产税累退性）估计出现重大偏差。
AI.motivation: 大数据在学术研究、政府决策和AI模型训练中的应用日益广泛，但数据经纪商对其数据来源、处理流程的透明度极低（即"数据谱系"不公开），这引发了"大数据悖论"——数据可能同时具备精确性和误导性。房产记录数据被广泛用于绅士化、不平等和财产税研究以及自动估值模型，但其数据质量从未被严格审计。本研究旨在填补这一空白，系统评估主流经纪商数据的准确性和代表性。
AI.method:
1. 以库克县2018-2021年独栋住宅公平交易为研究对象，将 ATTOM 和 Cotality 的经纪商数据与县行政开放数据（"真实值"）进行匹配比对。
2. 通过地址、地理坐标和销售日期进行模糊匹配（fuzzy matching）。
3. 识别两类错误：插补错误（imputation error，匹配后价格差异>5%）和覆盖错误（coverage error，未能匹配的合法交易）。
4. 通过对账记录手工验证县数据的准确性。
5. 分析两个经纪商之间错误的相关性（错误是否共享）。
6. 量化错误对三种财产税累退性指标（PRD、Suits Index、回归系数）估计的影响，并通过分解法区分插补错误和覆盖错误的相对贡献。
7. 在纽约市和费城进行稳健性检验。
AI.result:
1. **插补错误**：1-2%的匹配交易中，经纪商报告价格与真实价格差异超过5%，且差异通常为真实价格的简单倍数（如2/3、1/3、2倍），疑因使用错误的市镇转让税率进行价格插补；单笔误差可达数十万美元。
2. **覆盖错误**：12-15%的真实交易在经纪商数据中缺失，原因包括记录缺失（37%-56%）、属性过滤误报（如将公平交易标为止赎）、重复记录等。
3. **错误高度共享**：在两家经纪商间，3/4的价格异常交易完全重叠，且报告的错误价格几乎完全相同（99.8%）；50-60%的未匹配交易重叠，其中缺失记录的97%同时出现在两家数据集中。这与2018年FTC要求CoreLogic（Cotality前身）向RealtyTrac（ATTOM前身）共享数据的反垄断协议直接相关。
4. **影响显著**：两家经纪商数据对财产税累退性的估计在所有四年中均与真实值存在显著差异；ATTOM倾向于高估累退性，Cotality倾向于低估。覆盖错误是偏差的主导来源（尤其对Cotality），插补错误引入的则是较温和但一致的低估（衰减偏差）。
5. **纽约和费城**也存在类似但程度略轻的错误模式，结论具有可推广性。
6. 数据集聚合统计量看似一致，掩盖了交易级别的严重错误，简单的描述性比较无法发现这些问题。
AI.conclusion: 经纪商数据存在显著且系统性的覆盖和插补错误，错误在经纪商之间高度共享，传统的"更换数据源进行稳健性检验"方法无法有效识别或纠正这些错误，对学术和政策研究构成严重威胁。研究强调了三方面政策含义：(1) 迫切需要开放行政数据以便研究者验证；(2) 数据经纪商需披露数据来源与处理过程（数据谱系）；(3) 常规的极值剔除/缩尾处理无法应对此类错误，因为异常交易并非价格分布的尾部点。研究者应优先使用可获得的开放行政数据作为基准。

title: From Process to Evidence: How Computing Can Ground Appropriate Reliance on Legal AI
summary: Lawyers and self-represented litigants are already using artificial intelligence (AI) to draft legal documents, and courts are responding with rules. After more than 1,500 cases involving AI hallucinations, lawyers have been instructed to perform careful, independent review of AI-assisted filings. Discharging these duties requires what the human-computer interaction (HCI) literature calls ``appropriate reliance,'' which cannot be calibrated without evidence on how often, how badly, and how detectably these tools fail at legal work. Existing research barely describes any of the three. We analyze the official record of the New York court system. The documents repeatedly call for evidence that does not exist (e.g., error rates, do-not-use lists). In its place they invoke procedure, including training mandates, checklists, and uncalibrated human review. The burden falls hardest on those least equipped to bear it: legal aid programs are told to track their own error rates, and judges are left to improvise their own tests. The paper makes four contributions: (1) a mapping from the legal duties to concepts in HCI; (2) a set of requirements elicited from the official record; (3) an analysis of how the legal system substitutes process for evidence; and (4) a research agenda for computing, including task taxonomies, shared error metrics, maintained benchmarks, and test harnesses for evaluations on private data. The computing community must supply what the justice system lacks; in doing so, it can help close, rather than widen, the justice gap.

AI.tldr: 本文论证：法律 AI 的使用义务本质上是要求"适度依赖"(appropriate reliance)，但司法系统缺乏支撑该依赖的经验证据，于是以流程性合规(培训、清单、人工审查)替代证据。作者呼吁计算社区构建一套面向法律任务、可持续维护的评价基础设施(任务分类法、共享基准、可移植测试框架、构造真值的方法)。
AI.motivation: 生成式 AI 在法律行业的采用速度远超制度治理能力：律师与无代理当事人(SRL)已广泛使用 LLM 起草法律文书，已有 1500+ 起 AI 幻觉案件；纽约 22 NYCRR Part 161 与 ABA 512 号意见强制要求律师"理解工具的能力与局限""按比例验证""独立审查并签署"。然而这些义务的履行依赖于关于 AI 失败频率、严重性与可检测性的证据——而该证据几乎不存在。HCI 文献中的"适度依赖"概念表明，校准(calibration)、功能特异性(functional specificity)与依赖决策均需以按任务分层的误差率数据为前提。负担最终落在最无力承担者(法律援助、法官、SRL)身上。
AI.method: (1) 选取纽约州司法系统官方记录(法院规则、司法政策、律协报告、伦理指南、CLE 资料)为语料，进行文档分析；(2) 将法律义务映射至 HCI 框架：理解工具=校准；按比例验证=功能特异性；审查与签署=依赖决策；(3) 通过需求工程方法，从官方记录中抽取功能需求(9 项)与非功能需求(6 项)；(4) 对照现有学术研究与 eDiscovery/TAR 实践，评估当前证据缺口。
AI.result: 四方面贡献：(1) 法律义务→适度依赖的映射；(2) 需求文档(表 2)：F1–F9 涵盖按任务失败率、操作指标、比较评价、误差构造、阈值设定、共享基准、可移植测试框架、真值构造、调节元数据；N1–N6 涵盖任务粒度、时效性、来源、可保密性、输入鲁棒性、语言/法域多样性；(3) 揭示"以流程替代证据"的五种模式：政策程序、私人试点、人工审查、专家、本地测量、培训——共性缺陷为私密、过期、脱离情境；(4) 研究议程：任务分类法、参考答案构造、输出评分、可持续基准、测试工具、调节结果分析。现有研究(Dahl、Magesh、Liu、Salinas)覆盖范围过窄；eDiscovery 是唯一具备充分证据的领域，源于计算-法律跨学科合作。
AI.conclusion: 法律 AI 的"适度依赖"目前悬置于缺失的证据基础之上；流程合规不能替代按任务分层的实证测量。计算社区须承担起构建法律 AI 证据体系的责任——提供方法论与基础设施，法律社区提供领域知识与任务定义。唯有通过类似催生 TAR/eDiscovery 证据体系的持续跨学科合作，才能让法律 AI 缩小而非扩大司法鸿沟。

title: IyawoBench v2.0: Extended Diagnostic Evaluation of Large Language Model Clinical Triage in Nigerian Primary Care
summary: Large language models are being deployed as clinical triage tools in low and middle income countries where trained physicians are scarce. Existing safety metrics, however, produce misleading confidence: models scoring 100% on binary "did not send an emergency home" safety measures may nevertheless exhibit systematic failure modes that render them undeployable at scale. We present IyawoBench v2.0, an extended diagnostic evaluation of large language model clinical triage on 200 synthetic vignettes derived from 1,200 real patient encounters at 19 Nigerian primary health centres. We introduce a formal mathematical framework comprising fourteen definitions and two theorems that decompose triage safety into three distinct failure modes: Conservative Escalation Bias, Systematic Downgrade Bias, and Middle-Tier Instability. We propose the Escalation Bias Index and Expected Deployment Cost as novel metrics that expose failure modes hidden by conventional accuracy and sensitivity scores. Evaluated on three frontier models (Claude Sonnet 4.6, Llama 3.3 70B, Llama 3.1 8B) plus five naive baselines, we show that: (1) all three models exhibit at least one formal failure mode; (2) traditional sensitivity metrics conceal a 77 percentage point under-triage gap in Llama 3.1 8B; (3) the optimal model varies across three deployment scenarios (Emergency-Focused, System-Sustainability, Balanced), demonstrating that single-ranking benchmarks are inadequate for LMIC clinical AI selection. IyawoBench v2.0 provides both a rigorous benchmark and a diagnostic framework transferable to any triage-style clinical AI evaluation. All code, data, and analysis pipelines are publicly available.

AI.tldr: IyawoBench v2.0 是一个用于评估大语言模型在尼日利亚基层医疗分诊任务中表现的诊断式基准。它提出了一个包含14个定义和2个定理的形式化数学框架，将分诊安全性分解为三种失败模式（保守升级偏差CEB、系统性降级偏差SDB、中层不稳定MTI），并引入升级偏差指数（EBI）和预期部署成本（EDC）等新指标，揭示传统准确率/灵敏度指标所隐藏的系统性失败。
AI.motivation: 现有临床AI基准（如MedQA、PubMedQA、MedMCQA）以及IyawoBench v1.0主要关注孤立的问答准确率或二元安全性指标（"是否未将急诊送回家"），导致模型可能在该指标上获得100%分数却仍存在使其无法大规模部署的系统性失败模式。这种"虚假信心"在低中收入国家（LMIC）尤其危险，因为基层医疗缺少训练有素的医生，错误分诊会直接危及患者生命。论文旨在揭示这一评估盲点，并提供一种可诊断、可迁移的分诊评估框架。
AI.method: 1. 数据集：从尼日利亚奥约州19个基层医疗中心1,200次真实就诊记录中统计生成了200个合成临床案例，覆盖8种发热疾病类别（疟疾、伤寒、肺炎、细菌性脑膜炎、败血症等），分诊标签遵循WHO IMCI 2014、WHO疟疾指南2025等指南，三级分类：TREAT_HERE (y₀)、REFER_TODAY (y₁)、REFER_NOW (y₂)，分布为40/60/100。2. 形式化框架：定义了包括Escalation Bias Index (EBI)、Strict Sensitivity、Middle-Tier Confusion Rate (MCR)、Expected Deployment Cost (EDC)在内的15个度量，并证明两个定理（CEB架构无关性、CEB下EDC的下界）。3. 评估模型：Claude Sonnet 4.6、Llama 3.3 70B、Llama 3.1 8B，以及5个朴素基线（always_refer_now等）。4. 三种部署场景：急诊优先、系统可持续性、平衡部署，分别对应不同的成本矩阵。5. 统计推断：McNemar配对比例检验、Wilson置信区间、1,000次自助重抽样。
AI.result: 1. 所有三个前沿模型均至少展现一种正式失败模式：Claude Sonnet 4.6展现CEB（EBI=0.475，紧接0.65阈值），Llama 3.3 70B同时展现CEB、MTI和SDB三种模式，Llama 3.1 8B展现SDB。2. 传统宽松灵敏度指标（v1.0安全分）下三个模型均达100%，但严格灵敏度揭示Llama 3.1 8B仅23.0%——存在77个百分点的隐性降级差距，77例真实急诊被降级为24小时内复诊而非立即转诊。3. 最优模型因部署场景而异：急诊优先场景下朴素always_refer_now基线胜出（EDC=0.70）；系统可持续性场景下Llama 3.1 8B胜出（EDC=1.31）；平衡部署场景下Llama 3.3 70B胜出（EDC=1.86）。三个场景的最优模型无任何重叠，证明单一排名基准对LMIC临床AI选择根本不充分。4. 失败模式与模型架构或规模无相关性（CEB可由朴素的"全部转诊"基线产生），表明失败模式源于模型与临床决策结构的交互而非模型本身属性。
AI.conclusion: IyawoBench v2.0既是一个基准，也是一个诊断工具，展示了为什么传统的二元安全指标在序数临床决策空间中是不够的。其核心贡献在于：(1) 一个可迁移到任何具有非对称错误成本的序数临床AI评估任务的形式化框架；(2) 一个揭示隐性失败模式的失败模式分类法；(3) 证明了临床AI模型选择必须结合具体卫生系统成本权重，不能依赖单一排名。论文警告不要将该框架的诊断结果误读为反对LMIC临床AI部署——在许多场景下，比较对象是完全缺乏临床决策支持，而展现某些失败模式的模型仍可能大幅优于该基线。缓解策略应聚焦于提示工程和部署架构，而非单纯依赖模型选择。所有代码、数据与分析流水线以CC BY 4.0开源。

title: The Deployment Wall: A Diagnostic Framework and Instrument for Enterprise AI in the Deployment Era
comment: 19 pages, 6 figures, 8 tables. Introduces the Deployment Wall framework, the Seam Index diagnostic instrument (with an evidence-anchored scoring protocol), and the Deployment Debt construct; includes six falsifiable propositions and a research agenda
summary: Enterprise investment in generative artificial intelligence (AI) tripled in a single year to roughly US$37 billion, yet independent field research finds that about 95% of enterprise generative-AI pilots deliver no measurable profit-and-loss impact. We argue that the dominant explanation--that models are not yet capable enough--is mistaken, and that enterprise AI has entered a Deployment Era in which advantage derives not from model intelligence but from the removal of the organizational and architectural friction that prevents a capable model from reaching production. Building on the software-engineering literature on technical debt and machine-learning deployment, and on a structured synthesis of independent field studies, we make the diagnosis operational. We introduce three linked constructs and one measurement instrument: the Deployment Wall, a six-stage value-leak model that mechanically reproduces observed survival rates; the Seam Index, a reproducible 0-12 diagnostic that scores any platform by how many of six recurring friction "seams" it removes natively rather than leaving to the adopter; and Deployment Debt, a construct that reframes unresolved friction as a compounding, quantifiable liability. We specify a scoring protocol with evidence anchors so the instrument can be applied consistently, illustrate it on a worked platform-selection example, and derive six falsifiable propositions with a research agenda for validation. The framework converts an eight-figure platform decision from a benchmark comparison into an architecture comparison.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"部署墙"(Deployment Wall)框架,主张企业AI已进入"部署时代",瓶颈不在模型智能而在部署摩擦。作者构建了三个关联构念和一个测量工具:六阶段价值泄漏模型(Deployment Wall)、0-12分诊断量表(Seam Index)、将未解决摩擦量化为复合负债(Deployment Debt),并提出六项可证伪命题,将平台选型从基准比较转化为架构比较。
AI.motivation: 企业生成式AI投资一年内翻三倍至约370亿美元,但MIT NANDA等独立田野研究显示约95%的企业GenAI试点未产生可衡量的盈亏影响。主流解释——"模型还不够强"——被作者认为是误诊。真正的瓶颈在于组织与架构层面的摩擦阻碍了有能力的模型进入生产,这种错误诊断导致企业采取"等待更智能模型"的被动策略,而实际上主动部署能力建设才是当下最便宜的行动。该框架填补了文献中缺少的"可决策级、可复现的部署前平台比较工具"的空白。
AI.method: 本文为概念性与设计导向的贡献,而非实证研究。证据基础由两部分组成:(1)田野观察——作者作为独立顾问及全球技术服务企业部署负责人的参与式观察证据;(2)独立研究的结构化综合——整合MIT NANDA、RAND、S&P Global、McKinsey、BCG、Menlo Ventures等的调查、访谈与市场数据,辅以公开公司披露交叉验证。Seam Index配套明确评分协议(0/1/2三档,需跨职能小组打分,需证据锚定物),以保证可复现性并借鉴ML Test Score的rubric哲学。框架的边界条件被明确声明:最适用于中大型、受监管或数据敏感的组织。
AI.result: 核心成果包含:(1)Deployment Wall——六阶段价值泄漏模型(模型选型→集成→治理→工作流重构→企业采纳→实现业务价值),按各阶段适度流失率可机械复现田野观察到的个位数存活率;(2)六条反复出现的摩擦"Seam"——数据、身份与访问、安全与合规、治理、变革管理、成本——每条均有独立证据支撑;(3)Seam Index 0-12评分量表——量化平台原生移除摩擦的程度,带证据锚定的跨职能评分协议;(4)Deployment Debt三维度(财务、组织、竞争)构造,使摩擦可被量化为复合负债;(5)六项可证伪命题(如P1:生产落地概率与Seam Index关联性强于与基准排名;P6:多模型企业中优势集中于拥有身份/数据/治理seam的提供商);(6)新护城河论证——Moat已从模型层迁移至Seam层,且呈分布式分布于不同超大规模云厂商(微软:分发与身份;亚马逊:数据边界;谷歌:垂直整合)。
AI.conclusion: 智能时代奖励"率先获得最强模型"的组织,这一优势在模型商品化后必然消解;部署时代奖励更难复制的"将任何有能力的模型穿过六条Seam并融入工作"的组织与架构能力。管理上的明确任务是:停止仅按基准评估AI,改为按平台移除的Seam数评估平台;重构工作而非包裹工作;在部署债务复合前予以清偿。下一个十年的赢家不是等待更智能模型的人,而是把部署当作纪律来修炼的人。Agentic系统的兴起不降低Seam负担反而放大其影响,因此先在辅助场景中闭合六Seam,再扩展自主性,是审慎的过渡序列。研究的下一步是经验验证这些命题,特别是Seam Index是否真正成为生产成功的领先指标。

title: Hypergamigication Through Integrating Game Engines and Learning Management Systems: Ender's Game
summary: This paper discusses games, their use in education, and previous work on integrating game engines and learning management systems (LMS). It proposes a bidirectional integration where game environments are generated using LMS content, introducing the concept of hypergamification as the use of a comprehensive game environment rather than isolated game design elements. A working pilot implementation of an importable Unity package for Blackboard integration is demonstrated, along with a demo game that uses the developed package. The paper also discusses the limitations of the proposed approach and outlines avenues for future work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种游戏引擎（Unity）与学习管理系统（LMS，Blackboard）之间的双向集成方案，并引入了"超游戏化"（hypergamification）概念，即使用全面的游戏环境而非孤立的游戏设计元素。文章展示了一个可导入的Unity Blackboard集成包及其演示游戏。
AI.motivation: 游戏化学习在教育中越来越受到关注，但现有方法通常仅使用孤立的游戏设计元素（如徽章、积分），未能充分利用完整游戏环境的潜力。同时，游戏引擎与学习管理系统之间的集成也缺乏深入研究。本文旨在探索通过深度集成游戏引擎与LMS来增强教育体验。
AI.method:
1. 提出双向集成框架：利用LMS内容动态生成游戏环境；
2. 引入"超游戏化"（hypergamification）概念，将整个游戏环境作为学习激励工具；
3. 开发一个可导入的Unity包，实现与Blackboard LMS的集成；
4. 制作一个演示游戏验证所开发包的有效性。
AI.result: 成功开发并演示了一个用于Blackboard集成的Unity包及配套演示游戏，证明了该双向集成方案的可行性，但作者也承认该方法存在一定局限性。
AI.conclusion: 通过游戏引擎与LMS的深度双向集成以及"超游戏化"理念，可以为教育提供更具沉浸感的学习体验。当前实现作为概念验证有效，但仍需进一步研究以克服现有局限性并扩展应用范围。

title: The Tragedy of the Cognitive Commons: How AI Could Disrupt the Regeneration of Professional Expertise
comment: Author accepted manuscript. Published in Human Resource Development Review; the version of record is available at the DOI. Submitted 2 November 2025, accepted 6 July 2026, published online 26 July 2026. This is a work of the United States Government and is not subject to copyright protection in the United States (17 U.S.C. 105)
summary: Artificial intelligence is reshaping cognitive work, but Human Resource Development scholarship has treated this transformation as an organizational training challenge, leaving the collective regeneration of professional expertise unexamined. This conceptual paper introduces the Cognitive Commons framework, integrating commons theory, HRD scholarship, and distributed cognition to explain how rational AI adoption decisions can deplete the shared expertise pool professions require for renewal. The framework distinguishes Internalized Mastery (deep domain knowledge from sustained practice) from Distributed Mastery (orchestrating human-AI systems), and develops the Validation Tether: effective AI oversight depends on the expertise AI adoption may undermine. Early labor market and clinical evidence suggests possible disruption to expertise-regeneration pathways in highly AI-exposed sectors, though adoption is recent and the strongest signals come from leading sectors rather than all professions. Five factors determine occupational vulnerability, and governance arrangements may form across organizational, professional-association, and policy levels. The paper reframes expertise development as collective stewardship rather than organizational optimization, with implications for HRD theory and workforce policy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"认知公共池"(Cognitive Commons)框架，揭示AI在职业领域的理性采纳决策可能耗尽专业再生所需共享专业知识池的矛盾，主张将专业知识发展从组织优化重构为集体治理。
AI.motivation: 当前HRD研究将AI对认知工作的影响主要视为组织培训问题，忽视了专业知识集体再生的机制；作者试图填补这一空白，探讨AI采纳如何在职业层面削弱而非增强专业判断力。
AI.method: 概念性/理论建构研究——整合公共池理论(commons theory)、HRD学术成果与分布式认知(distributed cognition)，提出"内在化精通"(Internalized Mastery)与"分布式精通"(Distributed Mastery)的二分，并通过"验证纽带"(Validation Tether)概念阐述AI有效监管与专业知识之间的依存关系。
AI.result: 1. 提出五因素决定职业脆弱性(occupational vulnerability)；2. 早期劳动力市场与临床证据显示高AI暴露行业存在专业知识再生路径受损迹象(以领先行业信号最强)；3. 提出跨组织、职业协会与政策层级的治理安排框架。
AI.conclusion: AI采纳并非纯粹的技术优化问题，其对专业生态具有集体性外部效应；HRD理论与劳动力政策应将专家知识发展视为需多方协同的公共资源治理问题，而非单一组织的培训绩效议题。

title: Triangulating Across U.S. Federal AI Transparency Regimes
summary: Federal AI systems can deny benefits or flag individuals for deportation, but the public disclosures meant to make those systems visible are fragmented and unevenly detailed. This paper examines three existing U.S. federal transparency regimes---System of Records Notices (SORNs), Information Collection Requests (ICRs), and the AI Use Case Inventory---and asks how well they, individually and together, describe government AI use. We find that no single regime fully reveals how the government constructs or deploys AI: each discloses different aspects of a system, and the current disclosure infrastructure makes it very challenging for the public to track specific AI systems across regulatory regimes and over time. Persistent identifiers are absent, granularity varies widely, and the annual AI Use Case Inventory cycle means federal agencies can deploy systems months before appearing in any official record. Using hand-validated zero-shot classification and cross-document entity resolution, we contribute a triangulation method that links disclosures across all three regimes and present two case studies. Our case studies finds that linking records provides greater insight into government AI use, but even linked records would constitute insufficient oversight compared to what public reporting has revealed about the same systems. We trace each regime's disclosure weaknesses to its original administrative purpose, showing these gaps are structural, and offer recommendations focused on the AI Use Case Inventory as the mechanism best suited for public-facing transparency: (1) a broad and consistently applied AI system definition, (2) persistent system identifiers with cross-references to related disclosures, and (3) restored public visibility into risk management processes.

AI.tldr: 本文研究美国联邦政府现行的三类AI透明度披露机制——《系统记录通知》(SORNs)、《信息收集请求》(ICRs)和《AI用例清单》(AI Use Case Inventory),发现没有任何单一机制能完整揭示政府AI系统的构建与部署全貌。作者提出了一种基于零样本分类与跨文档实体解析的"三角验证"(triangulation)方法,用于跨机制链接披露记录,并以自动化目标系统(ATS)和Mobile Fortify两个高影响系统为例进行案例研究。
AI.motivation: 联邦AI系统可能拒绝公民福利或将个人标记为驱逐对象,而现有公开披露分散且详略不一。公众难以追踪特定AI系统在不同监管机制间的关联,持久化标识符缺失,披露粒度差异大,且《AI用例清单》的年度周期意味着系统可能在部署数月后才出现在官方记录中。作者旨在回答:现有联邦披露机制(单独或组合)能否有效揭示政府AI使用情况,跨机制比较能否揭示单一机制无法发现的问题。
AI.method: 1. 数据收集:覆盖2010-2025年共3,735条SORN、2018年1月至2026年3月共37,871条ICR,以及2023-2025年三个年度的AI用例清单。2. AI相关性识别:使用GPT-5.4 mini零样本分类(经人工校验,SORN准确率约69.7%,ICR约75%)识别AI相关记录,辅以关键词过滤。3. 跨机制链接:采用候选检索(TF-IDF+机构名+命名实体加权)、概率评分、LLM重排序、层次聚类的五阶段跨文档实体解析流水线,并手工标注评估集验证。4. 案例研究:深入分析ATS与Mobile Fortify两个高影响系统的跨机制披露。5. 构建公众可访问的Web工具govAIfiles.org。
AI.result: 1. 单一机制均无法完整呈现政府AI使用:每个机制披露系统不同方面,80%-97%的记录无跨机制链接;SORN中"人工智能"一词仅出现6次,词汇断层严重。2. ATS案例:2025年AI清单披露ATS内运行的10个机器学习模型(其中4个为高影响),但2006年首次发布的SORN至今未更新,且不含"人工智能""机器学习"等词汇;另有166个ICR将ATS列为数据下游处理方。3. Mobile Fortify案例:仅在AI用例清单中被直接命名,风险管控字段标注为"进行中",SORN/ICR中无对应记录,说明文件缺失是机构主动决定而非行政疏忽。4. 系统性问题被识别为结构性的:披露时滞、粒度不一致、任务蔓延(mission creep),根源在于各机制原本的行政目的不同。
AI.conclusion: 作者将披露缺陷追溯到各机制原始的行政逻辑,认为这些差距是结构性的,需在现有机制基础上改革而非推倒重来。核心政策建议聚焦于AI用例清单:(1)采用广泛且一致适用的AI系统定义(移除"principal basis"限制条款);(2)引入持久化系统标识符并与其他披露交叉引用;(3)恢复公众对风险管理流程的可见度。此外建议清单永久延续、针对高影响用例定制问题、提升公众可用性与档案保存。Web工具govAIfiles.org及代码已开源,以促进公众与研究者进一步利用。

title: LLM-Based Generative Retrieval for Snapchat Content Recommendation
summary: Pretrained large language models (LLMs) are promising retrieval engines because they combine rich semantic priors, strong sequence modeling capabilities, and favorable scaling behavior. However, turning a pretrained LLM into a generative retriever in production deployment raises several challenges: the model must learn an internal item vocabulary that was absent from pretraining, and generate valid item identifiers under strict latency and cost constraints. We address these challenges through the design and launch of SnapLGR, an LLM-based generative retrieval system for short-video recommendation at Snapchat. The system is built around three main designs. First, we construct semantic identifiers (SIDs) from multimodal item embeddings and enhance them with Personalized PageRank (PPR)-based co-engagement contrastive learning, resulting in improved codebook utilization, reduced collisions, and infused collaborative signal. Second, we use continued pretraining (CPT) to ground the introduced SID tokens before supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on user interaction sequences. Third, we make SnapLGR serving practical through TensorRT-LLM CUDA-backed beam search and a decentralized worker-loop architecture. In a live A/B test, the launched system increased View Time by 0.37%, Time Spent by 0.09%, Deep Sessions by 0.18%, and Deep Sessions Unique User by 0.11% relative to the existing TIGER-style generative retrieval baseline. We then decompose this offline gap under a fixed tokenizer and quantify the gains due to model architecture, scaling, and pretraining. Overall, our deployment shows that successful production SnapLGR requires joint design across representation learning, vocabulary grounding, and efficient training and serving.

AI.tldr: SnapLGR 是 Snapchat 部署的基于 LLM 的生成式检索系统，用于短视频推荐。其核心包含三项协同设计：(1) 利用 Qwen3-VL 多模态嵌入与 PPR 共参与对比学习构建语义标识符（SID）；(2) 通过持续预训练（CPT）将新 SID 词元锚定到 LLM 词汇空间，再进行监督微调（SFT）；(3) 基于 TensorRT-LLM 的 CUDA 束搜索与去中心化 worker-loop 架构实现高吞吐推理。在 7 天线上 A/B 测试中，相对既有 TIGER 风格基线，View Time 提升 0.37%、Time Spent 提升 0.09%、Deep Sessions 提升 0.18%、Deep Sessions Unique User 提升 0.11%。
AI.motivation: 工业级推荐系统依赖检索从海量候选中高效过滤。TIGER 等生成式检索（GR）范式虽将检索转化为序列生成，但仍使用随机初始化的 T5 编解码器。预训练 LLM 具备丰富的语义先验和良好的可扩展性，理论上更适合作为生成式检索器，但在生产部署中面临三大耦合挑战：(1) 词元化器设计——如何将多模态语义与协同信号压缩进 SID 并避免严重碰撞；(2) 词汇落地——SID 不存在于预训练词表中，需先建立语义对齐；(3) 高吞吐训练与推理——在严格 GPU 预算下支持宽束解码与频繁再训练。论文旨在回答：如何构建工业级 LLM 生成式检索系统？其相对 TIGER 基线的真实收益与离线增益来源是什么？
AI.method:
系统由四个相互依赖的组件构成：视频词元化器、两阶段 LLM 训练流水线、推理流水线（含 SID-to-video 物化）、高吞吐训练推理基础设施。

（1）多模态行为感知 SID：使用 Qwen3-VL-Embedding-8B 提取视频与 Gemini 2.5 Flash 生成文本描述的联合嵌入，通过残差量化器（RQ-VAE）离散化为三层 SID（码本宽度 1024/512/256）；训练目标包含重构损失、承诺损失，以及基于 PPR（共参与图上的两跳随机游走得分，P75 阈值筛选）的共参与对比损失，将协同信号注入 SID 空间。

（2）两阶段词汇落地：先用高斯随机初始化扩展 SID 词元嵌入，再以冻结 LLM 进行 CPT（仅训练 SID 嵌入，在 SID-to-description 任务上对齐语义），最后在用户 SID 交互序列上进行全参数 SFT。CPT 一次性预训练，SFT 按小时增量训练。

（3）高吞吐训练：叠加 torch.compile、FlashAttention-2 变长注意力、动态序列打包，叠加 H100 后实现 3.63× 端到端训练吞吐。

（4）高吞吐推理：TensorRT-LLM CUDA 束搜索（消除 Python 框架开销，9.3×）、去中心化 worker-loop 架构（去中心化调度，3.3×）、异步 I/O 重叠（1.49×），合计 45.7× 单 GPU 吞吐提升。

骨干模型为 Qwen3-0.6B。
AI.result: 离线：SnapLGR 在 Qwen3-VL SID 上 Pass@10 21.78%（2.51×）、Pass@32 34.67%（2.27×）、Recall@32 11.11%（2.40×）全面超越 T5 基线。SID 质量方面，Qwen3-VL+PPR_P75 利用率 49.1%、唯一性 32.1%、Gini 0.424，显著优于内部多模态基线。SID 落地方面，RSA 从随机初始化 0.016 经 CPT 提升至 0.322，SFT 后回落到 0.167。增益归因：(1) 解码器架构贡献最大——Qwen3 在相同参数量下较 T5 提升 1.30×–1.51×，且 T5 在 220M 的性能（Pass@32 23.03%）才接近 Qwen3 在 13M 的水平（23.07%）；(2) 预训练权重带来小幅但稳定的提升（Pass@10 +3.4%）；(3) CPT 进一步叠加 1.19% R@32 增益。训练与推理吞吐分别提升 3.63× 和 45.7×。线上：7 天 A/B 测试相对 TIGER 基线，View Time +0.37%（p=0.007）、Time Spent +0.09%、Deep Sessions +0.18%、Deep Sessions Unique User +0.11%，均统计显著。
AI.conclusion: SnapLGR 证明了 LLM 生成式检索在工业短视频平台的可行性，其成功依赖表征学习、词汇落地、训练与推理工程的端到端协同设计。两条关键实践经验：(1) 宽束生成的实用性离不开 CUDA 束搜索与去中心化 worker 架构等推理基础设施；(2) 解码器骨干架构是检索性能提升的主要驱动力，改进词元化与词汇落地带来更小但重要的叠加收益。未来工作将探索更大规模 LLM 骨干以利用更丰富的预训练世界知识。

title: TransX: Scaling Transformer-based Recommendation via Behavioral and Serving Stream Crossings
summary: Modern industrial recommender systems (RecSys) increasingly adopt Transformer-based sequence models, with an emerging paradigm that frames recommendation as next-token prediction over a unified monolithic user sequence. However, collapsing heterogeneous data sources -- such as long-term user behaviors and real-time serving events -- into a single monolithic token stream that obscures their distinct causal roles and temporal characteristics, leading to inefficient modeling and elevated training and serving costs. We propose TransX, a production-oriented encoder-decoder architecture that reformulates recommendation as a sequence-to-sequence action transduction problem. TransX explicitly decouples behavior-stream modeling from serving-event modeling and conditions next-action decoding on scalable cross-attention between nearline behavior encodings and real-time serving representations. To enable low-latency, high-QPS deployment, TransX is co-designed with an amortized serving strategy that combines incremental behavior encoding with per-request key-value caching, rendering serving latency insensitive to behavior sequence length. Extensive offline experiments and large-scale online A/B tests on LinkedIn's recommender systems show that TransX consistently outperforms state-of-the-art DLRMs and sequential baselines, and delivers substantial CTR lift (+6.0%) and conversion gain (+4.4%) while maintaining serving costs comparable to existing production models where our co-designed serving strategy reduces online computation by approximately 80%.

AI.tldr: TransX 是 LinkedIn 提出的面向工业部署的编码器-解码器架构，将推荐重新定义为基于"行为流-服务流交叉"（stream crossing）的序列到序列动作转导任务。该工作通过显式解耦长程用户行为流与实时服务事件流，并配合近线行为编码缓存与请求级 KV 缓存等模型-基础设施协同设计，在 LinkedIn 最大社交推荐场景的 A/B 测试中实现 CTR +6.0%、CVR +4.4% 的显著提升，同时在线计算量降低约 80%。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 Transformer 的工业推荐系统通常将异构数据源（长期用户行为与实时服务事件）拼成单一统一 token 流，存在两个核心问题：(1) 语义混淆——用户历史行为与系统曝光具有不同的因果与时序角色，但被建模为同质序列，削弱了对用户意图的捕捉；(2) 计算低效——序列显著变长，且每次候选请求都需重编码整个行为前缀，造成大量冗余计算与高昂的服务成本。该工作旨在同时解决推荐系统的建模精度与工业级服务效率问题。
AI.method: TransX 采用非对称编码器-解码器结构：(1) 行为流编码器 Φ_behavior 通过因果自注意力独立处理用户长期行为序列（subject embedding + 行为类型 embedding + 相对位置编码），可异步近线计算；(2) "Stream Crossing" 模块采用分组多查询稀疏交叉注意力（multi-query sparse cross-attention），候选生成专属 query，但共享行为流导出的 K/V，并结合 local-global 稀疏模式（局部滑动窗口 L_local=10 + 全局注意力池化锚点），将在线计算复杂度降至 O(m·L_local·d) 而非 O(m·L·d)；(3) 并行动作转导解码器使用 query-key softmax 解码（共享可学习动作 token 查询 Q_dec），并采用 DLRM 风格的 Deep & Wide 或 Transformer 预测头；(4) 训练采用单遍流式 seq2seq 范式，因果编码使行为前缀可一次性前向计算并复用至所有服务事件；(5) 服务侧协同设计：行为表示近线计算并缓存到磁盘（bf16 量化），请求级 KV 缓存 + 并行解码，使服务时延对行为长度不敏感。
AI.result: 离线（LinkedIn 180 天生产数据）：TransX 以 0.862 AUC / 0.273 AUPR / 0.648 gAUC 优于 LiDLRM、SASRec、TransAct、GRM 等基线，仅用基线约 20% 的在线计算量；消融表明移除交叉注意力下降 7-13%、移除编码器下降 15-28%、全注意力替代稀疏注意力仅带来 +2-4% 增益但计算大幅上升。训练端单遍 seq2seq 较传统逐事件训练每 epoch 节省约 50% 时间。在线（50-50 流量 A/B）：CTR +6.0%、CVR +4.4%、DAU +0.26%、首页浏览 +0.08%（均统计显著，p<10⁻⁴）；P99 时延在候选数 500 时降低 83%；按用户活跃度/历史长度分层均表现稳健，仅冷启动用户中性无收益。
AI.conclusion: TransX 验证了"模型-基础设施协同设计"可有效推进工业推荐系统的精度-成本 Pareto 前沿：通过显式建模行为流与服务流的交叉，使昂贵的 Transformer 计算可被精准投放到最关键的"候选-历史交互"位置，而非均匀散布于扁平 token 流；同时近线缓存 + KV 缓存使其能扩展到 180 天超长行为窗口。该工作确立了"Stream Crossing"作为下一代工业推荐的可扩展原则性框架，并展望通过引入对比损失扩展为统一的检索-排序一体化端到端模型。

title: Think2Go: Generative Next POI Recommendation with LLM Reasoning
comment: Accepted by KDD 2026 Research Track Cycle 1 (Oral presentation)
summary: Next Point-of-Interest (POI) recommendation task focuses on mining user behavioral preference patterns from historical check-ins to provide personalized suggestions for the next destination. Existing methods primarily rely on shallow contextual information and handcrafted feature interactions to predict the next POI. However, the inherent sparsity and complexity of user mobility patterns limit the computational capacity of non-reasoning models to capture deep intent, while large language models (LLMs) perform suboptimally because they lack a deep understanding of semantic IDs (SIDs) when SIDs are trained separately. To address these limitations, we propose Think2Go, a novel generative next POI recommendation framework, which enhances the model's comprehension of SID representations and explores diverse spatial-temporal patterns via test-time computational scaling. We unify supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL)-based reasoning within a single architecture, enabling joint optimization of memorization and adaptive reasoning to better retain user behavior patterns while exploring diverse user preferences. To further calibrate policy optimization in adaptive reasoning, we propose two advantage weighting mechanisms that integrate (1) prompt epistemic uncertainty, estimated via kernel density methods to assess the spatial-temporal periodic pattern alignment between queries and user history, promoting increased exploration under high epistemic uncertainty; and (2) reward-informed advantage scaling, captured by normalizing rewards against their maxima to adapt update magnitudes, thereby improving training stability and mitigating overfitting to noisy signals. This joint calibration forms an implicit curriculum learning strategy, delivering fine-grained, instance-aware policy updates that prevent entropy collapse and support robust exploration.

AI.tldr: Think2Go是首个基于LLM推理的生成式下一兴趣点（POI）推荐框架，通过统一监督微调（SFT）与强化学习（RL）推理，并提出两种优势校准机制（基于核密度估计的时空认知不确定性STEU与难度感知奖励差距DRG），在三个真实数据集（Foursquare-NYC/TKY、Gowalla-CA）上实现了优于现有LLM及推理方法的推荐性能，同时显著提升了对语义ID（SID）的理解与跨域泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有POI推荐方法主要依赖浅层上下文信息与人工特征交互，难以捕捉用户移动模式的深层意图；而基于LLM的生成式方法（如GNPR）由于语义ID（SID）的训练与模型解耦，导致LLM对SID理解不充分，在稀疏场景下表现欠佳。同时，传统RL推理框架存在三大挑战：(1) SFT与RL分阶段训练导致灾难性遗忘，记忆与推理割裂；(2) 策略优化对所有提示同等对待，忽视不同难度；(3) 组均值中心化优势估计会掩盖绝对奖励差距，导致更新幅度与难度无关。
AI.method:
1. **统一架构（Think→Go→Self-Correct→Answer）**：在单一自回归生成过程中融合SFT（Answer部分，标准下一token预测损失）与RL（Think+Go部分，基于DAPO策略梯度），通过Self-Correct token桥接两者，联合优化记忆与探索，整体损失为 L = L_SFT + α·L_CAPO。
2. **校准优势策略优化（CAPO）**：
   - **STEU（时空认知不确定性）**：基于核密度估计（KDE），分别对查询的时间（周期性）和空间（地理距离）维度计算与用户历史的对齐度，得到不确定性 p = β·(1-p_temporal) + (1-β)·(1-p_spatial)，鼓励在认知不确定高的样本上探索；
   - **DRG（难度感知奖励差距）**：通过 m = 1 - (R_max - R)/R_max 将优势按最大奖励归一化，保留绝对奖励信号，避免简单/困难样本获得相同优势分布；
   - **Token熵奖励**：将每token熵 e_t^i 加入优势，促进推理token的多样性；
   - 最终优势：Â_t^i = exp(γ·p·m) · (R_i - mean({R_i}))，去除Dr.GRPO中的方差项以避免偏差放大。
3. **渐进式奖励机制**：格式奖励分0.5/1.0两级（含长度阈值防奖励作弊），评估奖励按语义ID单元3/L细粒度打分。
4. **实现细节**：基于LLaMA3.1-8B + LoRA (rank=8)，VLLM推理采样，每prompt取50条最近check-in，beam size=15。
AI.result: 在NYC、TKY、CA三个数据集上，Think2Go的Acc@1分别达到0.3847、0.3239、0.2583，相较最强基线GNPR提升5.78%–7.49%，相较最强传统基线ROTAN提升17.47%–31.77%。消融实验验证了推理token、STEU、DRG、Token熵奖励四个组件的有效性（移除后Acc@1下降0.62%–4.5%）。在SID类别预测任务中，Think2Go较GNPR提升31.36%–61.15%，证明推理训练显著增强了对SID的语义理解。跨域迁移实验中，Think2Go在所有六组源-目标域迁移任务上均优于LLM4POI和GNPR，泛化能力更强。此外，Think2Go训练时间减少56.45%，测试时间减少64.29%，内存占用降低63.92%，效率显著优于Refine-POI。超参数分析显示最佳组大小G=4，缩放因子γ=0.5。
AI.conclusion: Think2Go通过统一SFT与RL推理架构，并提出基于核密度估计的时空认知不确定性（STEU）与难度感知奖励差距（DRG）双重优势校准机制，有效解决了LLM对语义ID理解不足及策略优化中难度不敏感的问题，形成隐式课程学习策略，实现了细粒度、实例感知的策略更新。该框架不仅在三个真实数据集上取得了SOTA性能，还显著提升了SID语义理解与跨域泛化能力，同时大幅降低了训练与推理的时间和内存开销，为基于LLM推理的生成式POI推荐提供了新范式。

title: EvoReason: Self-Evolving Reasoning Primitive-Guided On-Policy Distillation for Latent Reasoning in Generative Recommendation
summary: Generative recommendation benefits from reasoning-enhanced inference, and latent reasoning offers an efficient paradigm by encoding intermediate reasoning processes into compact continuous representations for latency-sensitive deployment. Despite its efficiency, existing latent reasoning approaches typically rely on directly distilling raw chain-of-thought (CoT) trajectories into latent representations, assuming that textual reasoning traces provide sufficient supervision. However, recommendation reasoning trajectories contain diverse reasoning processes with redundant expressions and unstable reasoning paths, making raw CoT supervision suboptimal for learning transferable latent reasoning representations. To address this challenge, we propose EvoReason, a self-evolving latent reasoning framework that adaptively aligns explicit reasoning supervision with the student's latent reasoning space through primitive-guided on-policy distillation. First, EvoReason extracts reusable reasoning primitives from high-quality agentic recommendation trajectories, where each primitive captures an essential reasoning behavior and serves as a pseudo-tool for structured teacher reasoning. Then, based on these primitives, we equip the teacher with primitive-aware reasoning capabilities, enabling it to generate structured CoT supervision with reduced redundancy and improved consistency. Finally, during latent reasoning optimization, EvoReason introduces a self-evolving on-policy distillation mechanism, where the primitive-guided reasoning process evolves according to the student's latent reasoning outcomes. Through this closed-loop co-evolution, policy updates continuously improve latent reasoning behaviors is refined according to the resulting latent reasoning outcomes, enabling progressively better-aligned CoT supervision and more effective reasoning transfer.

AI.tldr: EvoReason提出了一种基于推理原语引导的自我进化在策略蒸馏框架，用于生成式推荐中的潜在推理。它通过从高质量智能体轨迹中提取可复用的推理原语作为伪工具，构建自我进化的原语库来引导教师生成结构化CoT监督信号，并通过在策略蒸馏将显式推理能力压缩到紧凑的潜在表征中，实现无需显式推理链的高效推理。
AI.motivation: 现有潜在推理方法直接蒸馏原始CoT轨迹到潜在表征中，存在三个核心问题：(1)推理转移效率低下，因为原始CoT将高层推理行为与实例级语言表达纠缠在一起；(2)静态推理监督无法适应学生策略的持续演化；(3)缺乏可控的显式推理结构，导致推理轨迹多样且不一致，难以学习可迁移的潜在推理能力。
AI.method: 框架包含三个阶段：(1)从ReAct风格智能体轨迹中发现可复用推理原语并构建原语库；(2)通过监督微调训练具备原语调用能力的教师模型；(3)自我进化在策略潜在推理蒸馏，通过GRPO进行结果驱动的强化学习优化潜在策略，教师基于原语库对学生在策略行为进行细化，并通过置信度门控的OPD目标和潜在KV对齐损失将显式推理知识蒸馏回学生，同时原语库根据潜在推理结果持续进化，形成闭环协同演化。
AI.result: 在Beauty、Sports和工业数据集上的实验显示，EvoReason在Recall@5和NDCG@5上相比最强基线LASAR分别提升17.9%、17.1%和15.4%，在线A/B测试带来ADVV +8.11%、营收 +6.23%的提升。消融实验验证了原语库、进化机制和OPD三个组件的必要性，潜在推理机制保持与TIGER相当的推理延迟（0.55秒/样本），远低于OneRec-Think的6.7秒/样本。
AI.conclusion: EvoReason通过自我进化的原语引导机制有效解决了显式推理向潜在推理转移的难题，实现了适配潜在推理空间的动态CoT监督生成，为生成式推荐中的高效推理提供了一种新的自演化蒸馏范式，显著提升了推荐性能和冷启动场景下的表现。

title: Reproducing LightMem: Naive RAG Is Just as Good for Memory Management
summary: Long-term conversational agents require access to information from earlier interactions, such as a user's preferences, past requests, or previously mentioned facts. Repeatedly providing the full dialogue history can be expensive as conversations grow, so many memory approaches instead transform past interactions into compact entries that can be retrieved when needed. LightMem is a recent lightweight memory-management approach that reports strong effectiveness while maintaining relatively low construction cost. However, it still relies on a separate constructed memory representation and is evaluated with only one retriever, leaving unclear how sensitive its results are to retriever choice and whether memory construction discards answer-relevant information. In this study, we reproduce LightMem and compare it with Naive RAG, which retrieves directly from raw user turns. We recover LightMem's main configuration trend, but find that retriever choice is a major source of performance variation: changing only the retriever over a fixed LightMem store shifts answer accuracy from 58.1% to 75.5%. Constructed memories also do not consistently outperform raw-turn retrieval. Naive RAG generally performs better at matched retrieval depths, whereas LightMem performs better mainly under tight answering-token budgets. Oracle evaluation further shows that memory construction removes some answer-relevant information. Overall, LightMem offers a context-efficiency trade-off rather than a general advantage over Naive RAG. Its value depends on the retriever and available token budget, motivating future work on retrieval, reranking, query formulation, and their interaction with raw and constructed memory representations.

AI.tldr: 本文对LightMem长对话记忆管理方法进行复现研究，将其与直接基于原始对话轮次检索的Naive RAG基线进行系统对比。研究发现LightMem并非普遍优于Naive RAG：检索器选择是影响效果的主要因素（同一记忆库下准确率从58.1%到75.5%不等），原始轮次检索在匹配检索深度下通常更优，LightMem仅在回答token预算紧张时表现较好；Oracle评估表明记忆构建过程会损失部分答案相关信息。
AI.motivation: 1）现有LLM代理记忆系统（如LightMem、A-MEM、MemoryOS）将原始对话转换为结构化记忆条目以降低上下文开销，但其评估通常仅使用单一检索器，无法判断效果对检索器的敏感性。2）端到端准确率无法区分错误来源于记忆构建还是检索阶段。3）构造性记忆是否真的优于直接检索原始对话轮次尚不明确。这些问题限制了记忆管理方法的有效性归因与改进方向。
AI.method: 围绕三个研究问题展开：（RQ1）使用LongMemEval-S数据集（444题）、Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507生成模型、gpt-5.5评判器，复现LightMem三种配置（r=0.4/0.6/0.8与th=768/1024的组合），对比Full-context和Naive RAG基线；（RQ2）固定LightMem最佳配置的记忆库（r=0.8, th=1024），评估11种检索器（BM25、SPLADE-v3、PromptReps稀疏/稠密/混合、Qwen3-Embedding 0.6B/4B/8B及多种融合变体），通过Recall@10和准确率分析检索器影响，并设置Oracle参考条件；（RQ3）在匹配检索深度（k=3/5/10）和匹配回答token预算（约330/500/935 token）两种条件下，将LightMem与Naive RAG进行对比，并通过Oracle评估（直接喂入黄金证据）分离检索误差与构建信息损失。附录B用gpt-4o-mini重新评判以验证结论稳健性。
AI.result: RQ1：复现了配置排序趋势（r=0.8, th=1024最优，准确率70.7%），但绝对值与原文存在差异；LightMem在两个较高配置下超越Full-context（60.8%）和Naive RAG（67.3%），最低配置（r=0.4, th=768）仅57.0%，弱于两个基线。RQ2：固定记忆库下仅更换检索器，准确率从BM25的58.1%波动到Qwen3-Embedding-4B的75.5%（差17.4点），Recall@10从0.390到0.587；Oracle参考准确率为77.7%；融合检索未带来一致提升；多会话和偏好类问题受检索器影响最大。RQ3：匹配深度下Naive RAG平均优于LightMem 2.4–4.8点；匹配预算约330 token时LightMem领先5.5点，约500 token时领先2.2点，约935 token时反输0.9点；Oracle下Naive RAG达89.0%，LightMem仅77.7%（11.3点差距表明构建过程损失信息）；构造开销需约321次查询才能通过回答节省的token回收。
AI.conclusion: LightMem相对Naive RAG的优势是有条件的而非普遍的：其紧凑记忆仅在回答token预算紧张或检索器与构造表示兼容性较好时带来收益；在其他场景下会引入大量构建开销并损失答案相关信息。检索器选择、查询构建、重排序与记忆表示的交互对系统性能的影响不亚于记忆构建方法本身。原始对话应作为忠实证据来源保留，而构造性记忆应被视为受限上下文下的辅助检索单元。未来工作需联合研究检索与构建，并分别评估二者贡献以正确归因改进。

title: A Matrix Factorization Approach in Turnstile Streaming
summary: We define the $M$-point query problem in data streams. Given a fixed matrix $M$, the goal is to maintain a vector $x$ under turnstile updates and answer each query $u$ with an estimate $\widehat{y}_u$ satisfying $|y_u-\widehat{y}_u| \leq \varepsilon \|x\|_1$, where $y=Mx$. We show that if $M$ admits a factorization $M=AB$, where $A$ and $B$ have space-efficient representations, then there is a streaming algorithm using $O(\varepsilon^{-1}\|A\|_{2\rightarrow\infty}\|B\|_{1\rightarrow 1}+(\varepsilon^{-1}\|A\|_{\infty\rightarrow\infty}\|B\|_{1\rightarrow 1})^{2/3})$ words of memory. An important special case is the lower-triangular all-ones matrix, which corresponds to the quantiles problem with additive error $\pm \varepsilon n$, where $n$ is the database size. Our framework generalizes the dyadic approach of Cormode and Muthukrishnan (J. Algorithms, 2005) for turnstile quantiles, and simplifies and improves the analysis of the state-of-the-art dyadic CountSketch algorithms of Wang et al. (SIGMOD, 2013) and Luo et al. (VLDB, 2016). Our approach is also related to the matrix mechanism of Li et al. (VLDB J., 2015) in differential privacy: given a database $x\in\mathbb{R}^U$ and a matrix $M$, the mechanism outputs a private approximation to $Mx$, with the privacy-error tradeoff governed by a matrix factorization norm of $M$. We also improve the prior lower bound for quantiles with deletions, showing a memory lower bound of $\Omega(\varepsilon^{-1}\log U)$ words. We also show any factorization has $\|A\|_{2\rightarrow\infty}\|B\|_{1\rightarrow 1} = \Omega((\log^{1.5} U) / \log\log U)$. This lower bound is new, and shows that for quantiles, the dyadic CountSketch is nearly optimal amongst factorization-based approaches.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对turnstile数据流模型下的M-点查询问题，提出了一种基于矩阵分解的统一框架。对CountSketch误差之间的相关性给出了新分析（O(1/r³)界），并应用于分位数问题，在上界和下界两方面均有改进：上界达到O(ε⁻¹log^(3/2)U)，并证明任何基于矩阵分解的方法对该问题都几乎最优。
AI.motivation: 分位数估计在工业界有广泛应用（Yahoo、Spark、Google等），但现有turn流模型下存在上界与下界之间的差距（O(ε⁻¹log^(3/2)U) vs Ω(ε⁻¹)）。传统的dyadic CountSketch方法分析复杂且使用了每一层独立的sketch表。作者希望通过矩阵分解视角统一现有方法，简化分析并改进空间复杂度。
AI.method: 1) 定义M-点查询问题：维护向量x，使查询返回y=Mx的近似，要求误差仅依赖于‖x‖₁而非‖Mx‖₁。2) 核心算法：对Bx使用ℓ=5行的CountSketch并取中位数，再用A乘以估计值。3) 关键技术贡献：证明了median-of-5 CountSketch误差的协方差界为O(‖x‖₁²/r³)（比Cauchy-Schwarz给出的O(‖x‖₁²/r²)严格更强）。4) 通过碰撞数K的分情况分析（K=0,1,2,≥3）以及符号翻转对称性证明该相关性界。5) 使用伪随机生成器（PRG）欺骗半空间交集来实现去随机化。6) 矩阵分解下界证明利用鞅浓度与Haar泛函的"帐篷函数"在树路径上的正交性。
AI.result: 主要结果包括：(1) 定理1.2给出通用上界：若M=AB，则存在使用O(ε⁻¹‖A‖₂→∞‖B‖₁→₁ + (ε⁻¹‖A‖∞→∞‖B‖₁→₁)^(2/3))个机器字的算法；(2) 定理4.2对分位数问题得到O(ε⁻¹log^(3/2)U)的空间，简化了Wang等人[LWY+16]的分析；(3) 定理5.1改进下界：具有删除的rank查询需要Ω(ε⁻¹log(εn))个字，与仅插入流分离；(4) 定理6.1证明γ₂,₁(Q)=Ω(log^(1.5)U/log log U)，表明dyadic CountSketch在基于分解的方法中几乎最优。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了基于矩阵分解的turnstile流算法的统一框架，提出的相关界分析是CountSketch理论的重要进展。所得上界与下界在log log U因子内匹配，证明了dyadic CountSketch方法在分位数问题上的渐近最优性（针对分解类方法）。该框架还可推广到具有树状结构或小树宽的矩阵M，应用于指数衰减求和等场景。此外，本文揭示了流算法与差分隐私中矩阵机制之间的深层联系。

title: Succinct and Fast Tiny Pointer Hash Tables
comment: Comments: 16 pages, 13 figures. Author-prepared arXiv version of the PVLDB paper. Source code and experimental artifacts: this https URL . Standalone implementation for direct use: this https URL
summary: Hash tables sit on the critical path of many systems, yet modern designs still force a trade-off between fast operations and high memory overhead. We revisit this trade-off and present Tiny Pointer Hash Tables (TPHT), a family of practical hash tables that make two ideas from theory work at system scale: compressing pointers down to a byte, and encoding keys compactly so less metadata is needed. We engineer these ideas into two complementary designs. Chained-TPHT targets maximal space savings, and is to the best of our knowledge the first simple and practical succinct hash table design, achieving a footprint less than the total data size with constant-time operations. Flattened-TPHT targets latency, organizing data to keep the common case within a single cache miss while retaining strong space efficiency. Both variants support dynamic resizing without global pauses and integrate cleanly with 64-bit keys and values. Across YCSB and microbenchmarks, TPHT advances the latency-space Pareto frontier: Chained-TPHT reaches 105.4% space efficiency, and Flattened-TPHT achieves 83.4% space efficiency with up to 89.3% higher throughput than strong baselines. Together, these results show that techniques primarily known in theory can be turned into production-ready hash tables that meaningfully reduce memory use while delivering state-of-the-art performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Tiny Pointer Hash Tables (TPHT) 哈希表家族，将理论上的"微指针（tiny pointers）"和"键商化（quotienting）"两种技术工程化为实用的哈希表设计。包含两个互补变体：Chained-TPHT（极致空间节省，可超过 100% 空间效率）和 Flattened-TPHT（单缓存未命中延迟，83.4% 空间效率且吞吐量提升高达 89.3%）。这是首个简单实用的简洁哈希表（succinct hash table）设计。
AI.motivation: 现代低延迟哈希表存在快速操作与高内存开销之间的权衡。现有最先进的哈希表仅将一小部分内存用于实际数据，大量空间被元数据和冲突解决机制占用。论文旨在回答两个核心问题：实际哈希表能将内存使用压缩到接近信息论下界的程度吗？同时能否保持与当前 SOTA 设计相当的吞吐量？
AI.method: 两种核心技术：(1) 微指针（tiny pointers）——通过"解引用表（dereference table）"将 64 位指针压缩到 8 位，采用基于二次幂选择（power-of-two-choice）的双哈希桶实现，实测在 98.2% 负载因子下无失败运行；(2) 键商化（quotienting）——使用一轮 Feistel 置换让键的某些位"看起来随机"，从而可通过桶索引隐式重建，省去显式存储约 log n 位。两个变体设计：Chained-TPHT（链表式 + 高负载解引用表 + 商化键，目标为 succinct 哈希表）；Flattened-TPHT（扁平化缓存行敏感的 home block 布局 + SIMD 指纹并行比较 + 1–3 次缓存未命中）。两者均支持 64 位键值、删除、无全局暂停的在线协作式 resizing（采用 seqlock 乐观并发控制 + 分区错峰 staggered 策略）。
AI.result: 在 YCSB 基准（16 线程）上：Flattened-TPHT 负载阶段 226.9 M ops/s、运行阶段 310.4 M ops/s，分别是最高基线的 1.84× 和 1.94×；Chained-TPHT 负载阶段 99.5 M ops/s、运行阶段 153 M ops/s。空间效率方面：Chained-TPHT 达到 105.4%（高于原始数据大小），比最强基线节省 38.6% 内存；Flattened-TPHT 达到 83.4%，节省 22.3% 内存且吞吐量提升高达 89.3%。相对紧凑哈希表，Chained-TPHT 插入速度比 Bucketing 快 9.8×，比 Cleary 快 62.5%。可扩展性：两种设计线程扩展比 0.908–0.925，近线性；支持 2^11 至 2^27 规模数据集。Resizing 期间 99 分位插入延迟分别 541 ns / 778 ns，比 Cuckoo 的 2.7 μs 低近一个数量级。Staggering 技术使 Chained-TPHT 最差空间效率达 46.7%（vs IcebergHT 32.6%）。
AI.conclusion: 论文证明了理论上已知的微指针和键商化技术可以被工程化转化为生产级哈希表。Chained-TPHT 是首个实用的简洁哈希表，Flattened-TPHT 将延迟-空间帕累托前沿向前推进。两者均支持删除和无全局暂停的在线 resizing，与 64 位键值系统良好集成。代码已开源。后续工作可探索将微指针/解引用表机制推广到其他指针密集型数据结构，以及针对不同工作负载的自适应商化和布局策略。

title: Nonlinear Exchange Dynamics for Independent Sets
summary: In recent years, nonlinear dynamics derived from kinetic theory have gained attention in the context of sampling configurations of spin systems such as the Ising model. We focus on nonlinear dynamics for the hard-core model, a canonical spin system with hard constraints that specifies a distribution over independent sets in a graph, weighted by their sizes. We explore two distinct types of nonlinear dynamics: the mean-field dynamics, which preserves the density (or average size) of independent sets, and the single-site dynamics, which preserves the marginal vector (i.e., the occupancy probabilities of the vertices). These dynamics are natural stochastic processes for sampling from the hard-core model with a specified density or marginal vector, respectively, both of which are canonical instances of maximum entropy distributions that have been studied in various contexts. In contrast to linear Markov chains, there is a significant lack of a fundamental theoretical framework for nonlinear dynamics. We develop foundational theoretical tools for analyzing nonlinear dynamics within the context of the hard-core model. We establish almost linear convergence of both the mean-field and single-site dynamics at sufficiently low density through novel coupling arguments. We also establish exponential decay of relative entropy for the mean-field dynamics all the way up to the critical density. Additionally, we design new algorithms for sampling from the hard-core distribution with either a specified density or a specified marginal vector. These algorithms are based on a related linear Markov chain, called the particle-system dynamics and inspired by the so-called Kac's program, that approximates the associated nonlinear dynamics. As we demonstrate in the paper, they are comparable in time complexity, but simpler to implement, than traditional approaches based on learning parameter values.

AI.tldr: 本文针对硬核模型（hard-core model）的采样问题，系统研究了两种非线性动力学方法：均值场动力学（保持独立集密度）和单点动力学（保持边际概率向量）。作者建立了收敛性理论框架，并通过粒子系统动力学构造了实际可用的采样算法。
AI.motivation: 硬核模型作为典型的带硬约束的自旋系统，其采样问题是统计物理与计算机科学中的核心问题。传统的线性马尔可夫链（如 Glauber 动力学）已有成熟理论框架，但针对保持特定密度或边际向量的最大熵分布采样时，非线性动力学缺乏系统理论基础。作者旨在填补这一理论空白。
AI.method: 1. 研究两类非线性动力学：均值场动力学（保持独立集平均大小）和单点动力学（保持顶点占用边际概率）。2. 通过新颖的耦合论证证明低密度下两种动力学的近线性收敛性。3. 证明均值场动力学在直至临界密度均呈相对熵指数衰减。4. 基于 Kac 程序的灵感，设计粒子系统动力学（particle-system dynamics）这一线性马尔可夫链来近似非线性动力学，并据此提出新的采样算法。
AI.result: 1. 理论上：在足够低密度条件下，均值场和单点动力学均实现近线性收敛；在直至临界密度范围内，均值场动力学的相对熵呈指数衰减。2. 算法上：基于粒子系统动力学的采样算法在时间复杂度上与传统参数学习方法相当，但实现更简单，可用于指定密度或边际向量的硬核分布采样。
AI.conclusion: 本文为硬核模型下的非线性动力学奠定了理论基础，证明了其在低密度（以及均值场情形下的全临界密度范围）的快速收敛性，并提出了基于粒子系统近似的实用采样算法，为最大熵分布采样问题提供了新的理论框架和算法工具。

title: Structural Tractability Frontiers for Metric Repair
summary: Given a graph $G$ labeled with positive distances on each edge, what is the fewest number of edge distances that must be modified for $G$ to become a metric? It is known that this metric repair problem is $\mathrm{NP}$-hard on general graphs, with prior work focusing on approximations and fixed-parameter tractability with respect to properties of the input distance function. In this paper, we ask what structural properties of the graph itself make metric repair tractable. On the positive side, we give pseudo-polynomial time algorithms for series-parallel graphs, and by generalization, graphs of bounded treewidth. An immediate consequence of this result is a new algorithm for the length-bounded multicut problem, with a parameterized runtime bound in terms of the treewidth of a modestly augmented graph. Surprisingly, pseudo-polynomial time turns out to be the best one can hope for: We complement our algorithm with a proof that metric repair is weakly $\mathrm{NP}$-hard even on graphs of pathwidth at most six. We also prove that planarity does not help either, as the problem remains strongly $\mathrm{NP}$-hard even on grid graphs.

AI.tldr: 本文研究度量修复（Metric Repair）问题的结构性可解性边界。给定带正边权的图，最少修改多少条边的权值才能使其成为度量（即满足三角不等式）。作者从图的拓扑结构和权值范围两个维度刻画了该问题的可计算性边界：正面上，对有界树宽图给出了伪多项式时间算法（参数化于树宽r和最大权值W）；反面上，证明了即使在路径宽≤6的图上度量修复仍是弱NP困难的，且在平面图乃至网格图上仍是强NP困难的，即使权值仅有常数种取值。
AI.motivation: 度量修复源于实际数据清洗需求：现实中的距离数据（如聚类、最近邻搜索所依赖的距离矩阵）常违反三角不等式，而大量算法隐式假设了度量性。然而之前的复杂性研究只关注一般图的近似算法和参数化算法，对什么样的图结构能让该问题变得精确可解并不清楚。本文旨在填补这一空白，精确界定度量修复在图结构维度和权值维度上的可解性边界。
AI.method: 技术核心是基于"距离-需求剖面"（distance-demand profile）的动态规划。算法层面：在串联-并联图上，利用Valdes-Tarjan-Lawler分解，对每个二端子子图维护距离d（端子间最短路）和需求λ（未来外部路径必须满足的最低长度才能避免产生破坏环）。状态数为O(W²)，每个组合操作O(W⁴)，总时间O(W⁴·|E|)。推广到有界树宽图后，使用nice树分解，状态变为两个矩阵（距离矩阵和需求矩阵），状态数变为W^{O(r²)}，得到FPT算法（参数化为(r,W)）。硬度层面：使用三种不同的归约——基于Partition问题的链状小器具构造pathwidth≤6的弱NP困难；通过独立集→边定向→度量修复的局部小器具构造平面图的强NP困难（仅用权值1,4,13）；最后通过rectilinear layout和块结构构造将平面硬度传递到网格图，利用对偶性论证声音性。
AI.result: 主要结果包括：1）串联-并联图上IO-Metric-Repair可在O(W⁴·|E|)时间内求解；2）树宽≤r的图上可在W^{O(r²)}·(|V|+|E|)时间内求解，即FPT（参数为r和W）；3）该算法对长度有界多割问题给出新算法，运行时间L^{O(r²)}·(|V|+|E|+k)，其中r为增广图的树宽；4）证明即使在pathwidth≤6的图上Metric-Repair和IO-Metric-Repair都是弱NP困难的；5）平面图乃至网格图上，即使权值仅为常数集{1,4,13}，问题仍是强NP困难的。这些结果精确刻画了可解性边界位于树宽2（串联-并联图）和路径宽6之间。
AI.conclusion: 本文定位了度量修复问题在两个结构性维度上的精确可解性边界：平面性无济于事（即使权值有界问题仍然困难），而有界树宽只在权值也有界时才有用。具体地，可解性边界落在串联-并联图（树宽2）和路径宽6之间，且权值的依赖是不可避免的（伪多项式时间已是最佳可能）。算法技术——基于距离-需求剖面的动态规划——也为长度有界多割问题提供了改进，特别是当终端对之间存在短且低拥塞路径时，运行时间的指数部分不再依赖于终端对数量k。开放问题包括：树宽2下是否存在真正的多项式时间算法（关于权的二进制编码），或者是否可证弱NP困难；以及平面二值权值度量修复问题的复杂性。

title: The Kikuchi Hierarchy is Sharp for $k$XOR
summary: Planted noisy $k$XOR and the strong refutation of random $k$XOR are governed by a conjectured trade-off between signal strength and time: Level $\ell$ of the Kikuchi hierarchy should achieve the smooth curve \begin{equation*} m\ \gtrsim\ \rho^{-2}n^{k/2}/\ell^{k/2-1}\ \text{clauses} \quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad \text{solvable in time }n^{O(\ell)}, \end{equation*} where $\rho$ is the bias of the planted signal or, for refutation, the target advantage. However, every spectral analysis of sparse $k$XOR to date loses polylogarithmic factors against this curve, a loss that enters the exponent of the running time. We show that a normalized variant of the Kikuchi hierarchy achieves the sharp conjectured trade-off, with no logarithmic loss, at every arity $k\ge3$. At the scale above, our algorithms achieve strong detection, weak recovery, and strong refutation; an additional cleanup step boosts weak recovery to exact recovery, and the refutation certificates yield sum-of-squares proofs of degree $O_k(\ell)$. We also prove matching lower bounds in the same model. The inference and refutation upper bounds transfer to more general planting laws and predicates. Finally, we give a quantum algorithm that achieves a quartic speedup over the classical spectral algorithms for detection and weak recovery. The proofs rest on two key ingredients: a normalization of the sparse Kikuchi matrix, and a sharp count of the closed walks in its trace expansion. We use a closely related trace-walk count to prove Feige's 2008 hypergraph Moore bound conjecture in a companion paper.

AI.tldr: 本文证明归一化的Kikuchi层级算法在稀疏planted noisy kXOR问题上达到推测的尖锐信噪比-运行时间权衡曲线 m ≳ ρ^(-2)n^{k/2}/ℓ^{k/2-1}，去除了此前所有谱分析方法中存在的多对数因子损失，并在同一模型中证明匹配的符号次数下界，给出量子四倍加速，并推广到布尔CSP。
AI.motivation: Planted noisy kXOR问题是统计-计算差距的核心范例。统计物理推测Kikuchi层级ℓ的算法应实现平滑权衡 m ≳ ρ^(-2)n^{k/2}/ℓ^{k/2-1} ↔ n^{O(ℓ)}时间。然而此前所有稀疏kXOR谱分析都存在多对数因子损失（从对数^4k+1降至单对数甚至更少），该损失进入运行时间的指数——对于超多项式算法而言，这是不可接受的。移除这些因子自层级引入以来一直悬而未决。
AI.method: 核心技术由两个要素构成：(1) 局部归一化的Kikuchi矩阵 Γ=D+d̄I，K=Γ^(-1/2)AΓ^(-1/2)，其中真实度D处理高度稠密行，确定性地板d̄I处理稀疏行（这种"度加均值"权重处理偶数k，奇数k使用成对方案与单调补全）；(2) 通过步迹方法对闭合行走进行尖锐计数：展开 Tr(K^{2t})，对随机符号取期望仅保留偶数重数的行走，将每个行走按时间顺序分解为打开（首次使用某子句）与关闭（重用活动子句），利用"超额"χ控制活动合法子句数。对偶k直接应用单标签步迹定理；奇k使用"精确二规则"与封顶补全的对称对步迹定理。验证四个结构假设(P1)-(P4)。下界通过符号多项式的Walsh展开在固定样本模型中精确计算奇偶边界概率。最后通过Jordan-to-RDM转移、下算子与谱投影等得到恢复；再通过独立的"清理池"多数投票提升至精确恢复；用精确惯性测试转化为SoS证明。
AI.result: 在 m ≳ ρ^(-2}𝔻_{k,ℓ} 的样本尺度上（无对数损失），对所有 k≥3 偶奇两性实现：强检测、弱恢复、精确恢复（添加 O_k(ρ^{-2}n log n) 个清理子句）；双侧强反驳（提供点态可靠证书与度数 O_k(ℓ) 的SoS证明）。在同一固定 m 模型中证明匹配符号次数下界：对检测为 mρ^2D^{k/2-1}/n^{k/2}，对恢复亦匹配。给出在反向只读输入模型中门复杂度 Õ(N_L^{1/4} L^{O_k(L)} n^{O_k(1)}) 的量子四倍加速（其中 L=k⌊ℓ/k⌋）。转移至固定已知非均匀种植律（每个非平凡Fourier字符是一个有噪XOR通道）和固定谓词的均匀随机作用域/随机字面模型，传递反论据但获得log-free推断与反驳上界。关键中间结果：Feige 2008超图Moore界猜想（在伴随论文中证明）。
AI.conclusion: 本文闭合了planted noisy kXOR中信噪比-运行时间权衡的对数差距问题，建立归一化Kikuchi矩阵作为该域的标准谱工具。尖锐性任务特定：检测与点态有界恢复匹配符号次数禁制，清理项匹配全样本极小极大率；反驳上界为log-free但其典型SoS下界存在多对数间隙。规范化技术可推广至一般布尔CSP，并通过尖锐闭合行走计数解决Feige超图Moore界猜想。开放问题包括匹配SoS下界、稠密奇k单元控制、非谱加速及常数最优性。
